info.description: Alpha Cognition, Inc. is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company that develops treatments for underserved neurodegenerative diseases such as Alzheimer's Dementia and Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis. It has additional pre-clinical development programs: ZUNVEYL in combination with memantine for the treatment of moderate-to-severe Alzheimer's disease, ALPHA-1062 sublingual formulation, ALPHA-1062 intranasal ("ALPHA-1062IN") formulation for the treatment of cognitive impairment with mild traumatic brain injury (mTBI, otherwise known as concussion) and ALPHA-0602, ALPHA-0702 & ALPHA-0802. The company was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Grapevine, TX.
info.description_zh: Alpha Cognition, Inc. 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於開發針對治療不足的神經退化性疾病（如阿茲海默症和肌萎縮側索硬化症）的治療方法。該公司還有其他臨床前開發項目：ZUNVEYL聯合美金剛治療中重度阿爾茨海默病、ALPHA-1062舌下含服製劑、ALPHA-1062鼻內製劑（“ALPHA-1062IN”）用於治療輕度創傷性腦損傷（mTBI，又稱腦震盪）認知障礙以及ALPHA-0602、ALPHA-0702 ＆阿爾法-0802。該公司成立於 2000 年，總部位於德克薩斯州格雷普韋恩。

info.description: JPMorgan ActiveBuilders Emerging Markets Equity ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its assets in equity securities and equity-related instruments that are tied economically to emerging markets. The equity securities and equity-related instruments in which it may invest include, but are not limited to, common stock, participation notes or other structured notes, and other instruments that provide economic exposure to one or more equity securities. The fund may also use exchanged-traded futures for the efficient management of cash flows.
info.description_zh: 摩根大通 ActiveBuilders 新興市場股票 ETF 旨在提供長期資本增值。正常情況下，該基金至少80%的資產投資於與新興市場經濟相關的股本證券和股票相關工具。其可能投資的股本證券及股本相關工具包括但不限於普通股、參與票據或其他結構性票據，以及提供一種或多種股本證券經濟風險的其他工具。該基金還可以使用交易所交易的期貨來有效管理現金流。

info.description: iShares MSCI All Country Asia ex Japan ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI AC Asia ex Japan Index. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the index. The index is a free float-adjusted market capitalization index designed to measure equity market performance of securities from the following 10 developed and emerging market countries or regions: China, Hong Kong, India, Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore, South Korea, Taiwan and Thailand.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI All Country Asia（日本除外）ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI AC Asia（日本除外）指數的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於該指數的組成證券以及具有與該指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該指數是自由流通市值指數，旨在衡量以下 10 個已開發和新興市場國家或地區證券的股票市場表現：中國、香港、印度、印尼、馬來西亞、菲律賓、新加坡、韓國、台灣和泰國。

info.description: iShares MSCI Emerging Markets Asia ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI EM Asia Custom Capped Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the underlying index. The underlying index is designed to measure equity market performance in the emerging market countries of Asia. The underlying index includes large- and mid-capitalization companies and may change over time.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI 新興市場亞洲 ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI 新興市場亞洲客製化上限指數的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及具有與標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。相關指數旨在衡量亞洲新興市場國家的股票市場表現。基礎指數包括大中型公司，並可能隨著時間的推移而變化。

info.description: Tenax Therapeutics, Inc. is a pharmaceutical company engaged in the development and commercialization of products for cardiovascular and pulmonary diseases. The company was founded on May 26, 1967 and is headquartered in Chapel Hill, NC.
info.description_zh: Tenax Therapeutics, Inc.是一家從事心血管和肺部疾病產品的開發和商業化的製藥公司。該公司成立於 1967 年 5 月 26 日，總部位於北卡羅來納州教堂山。

info.description: Invesco DWA Developed Markets Momentum ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Dorsey Wright Developed Markets Technical Leaders Index (the "underlying index"). The fund will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index is comprised of equity securities of large capitalization companies classified as developed markets, excluding the United States.
info.description_zh: Invesco DWA 已開發市場動量 ETF 旨在追蹤 Dorsey Wright 已開發市場技術領先指數（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。該基金將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。基礎指數由歸類為已開發市場（美國除外）的大型市值公司的股本證券組成。

info.description: Defiance AI & Power Infrastructure ETF seeks to track the performance, before fees and expenses, of the MarketVector US Listed AI and Power Infrastructure Index. The index is a thematic index tracking the performance of U.S. exchange-listed companies contributing to critical electrical grid, artificial intelligence ("AI") and data infrastructure through decentralized energy technologies, electrical utilities and related components and construction, data center operations, and AI-related computing hardware. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's net assets will be invested in securities of AI & Power Infrastructure Companies. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance AI 和電力基礎設施 ETF 旨在追蹤 MarketVector 美國上市的 AI 和電力基礎設施指數（未計費用和開支）的表現。該指數是主題指數，追蹤美國交易所上市公司透過去中心化能源技術、電力公用事業及相關組件和建設、資料中心營運以及人工智慧相關運算硬體為關鍵電網、人工智慧（「AI」）和資料基礎設施做出貢獻的業績。一般情況下，基金淨資產的至少80%將投資於人工智慧和電力基礎設施公司的證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Russell Inv Emerging Markets Equity Active ETF seeks to provide long term capital growth. The fund has a non-fundamental policy to invest, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the value of its net assets plus borrowings for investment purposes in equity securities economically tied to emerging markets countries. The fund principally invests in equity securities, including common stock and preferred stock, of emerging markets companies, and in depositary receipts representing shares in such companies.
info.description_zh: Russell Inv Emerging Markets Equity Active ETF 致力於提供長期資本成長。該基金的非基本政策是，在正常情況下，將其淨資產價值的至少80%加上用於投資目的的借款投資於與新興市場國家經濟相關的股本證券。該基金主要投資於新興市場公司的股本證券，包括普通股和優先股，以及代表此類公司股份的存託憑證。

info.description: Comfort Systems USA, Inc. engages in the provision of mechanical and electrical contracting services. It operates through the Mechanical and Electrical Services segments. The Mechanical Services segment includes heating, ventilation, air conditioning, plumbing, piping, and controls, as well as off-site construction, monitoring, and fire protection. The Electrical services segment focuses on installation and servicing electrical systems. The company was founded by Alfred J. Giardinelli, Jr. And William George III on December 12, 1996 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.description_zh: Comfort Systems USA, Inc. 從事提供機械和電氣承包服務。它透過機械和電氣服務部門運作。機械服務部門包括暖氣、通風、空調、管道、管道和控制，以及場外施工、監控和消防。電氣服務部門專注於電氣系統的安裝和維修。該公司由 Alfred J. Giardinelli, Jr. 和 William George III 於 1996 年 12 月 12 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州休斯頓。

info.description: Janus Henderson Global Artificial Intelligence ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. The fund pursues its investment objective by investing, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in equity securities of companies that portfolio management believes will contribute to or benefit from artificial intelligence technologies. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Janus Henderson Global Artificial Intelligence ETF 尋求資本的長期成長。在正常情況下，該基金透過將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於投資組合管理認為將有助於人工智慧技術或受益於人工智慧技術的公司的股本證券來實現其投資目標。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares MSCI Emerging Markets ex China ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI Emerging Markets ex China Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of its index and may invest up to 20% of its assets in certain futures, options and swap contracts, cash and cash equivalents. The index is a free float-adjusted market capitalization-weighted index that captures large- and mid-capitalization stocks across 23 of the 24 Emerging Markets countries, excluding China.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI 新興市場（中國除外）ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI 新興市場（中國除外）指數（「基礎指數」）的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於該指數的組成證券以及具有與其指數組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資，並可能將最多 20% 的資產投資於某些期貨、選擇權和掉期合約、現金和現金等價物。該指數是一個自由流通量調整後的市值加權指數，涵蓋 24 個新興市場國家中 23 個國家（不包括中國）的大中型股票。

info.description: WisdomTree Emerging Markets Quality Dividend Growth Fund seeks income and capital appreciation. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing primarily in emerging market dividend-paying common stocks with growth characteristics. The adviser, using a disciplined model-based process focused on a long-term approach to investing, seeks to identify dividend-paying companies with strong corporate profitability and sustainable growth characteristics. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WisdomTree新興市場優質股息成長基金尋求收入和資本增值。該基金尋求透過主要投資於具有成長特徵的新興市場派息普通股來實現其投資目標。該顧問採用基於模型的嚴格流程，專注於長期投資方法，力求識別具有強勁企業盈利能力和可持續增長特徵的派息公司。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Webull Corp. engages in the provision of financial services. It offers trading, wealth management product distribution, market data and information, user community, and investor education. The company was founded by An Quan Wang in 2016 and is headquartered in St. Petersburg, FL.
info.description_zh: Webull Corp. 從事提供金融服務。 It offers trading, wealth management product distribution, market data and information, user community, and investor education.该公司由王安泉于2016年创立，总部位于佛罗里达州圣彼得堡。

info.description: Anixa Biosciences, Inc. is a biotechnology company, which engages in the development of therapies and vaccines focused on oncology. It operates through the following segments: Cancer Vaccines, CAR-T Therapeutics, and Other. The Cancer Vaccines segment includes the early stages development of immunization for breast and ovarian cancer. The CAR-T Therapeutics segment is involved in the development of immuno-therapy drugs against cancer. The Other segment refers to its legacy operations, including patent licensing. The company was founded on November 5, 1982 and is headquartered San Jose, CA.
info.description_zh: Anixa Biosciences, Inc.是一家生物技術公司，致力於開發專注於腫瘤學的療法和疫苗。它透過以下部門運作：癌症疫苗、CAR-T 治療和其他。癌症疫苗部分包括乳癌和卵巢癌免疫的早期開發。 CAR-T Therapeutics 部門參與癌症免疫治療藥物的開發。其他部門指的是其遺留業務，包括專利許可。該公司成立於 1982 年 11 月 5 日，總部位於加州聖荷西。

info.description: Keysight Technologies, Inc. engages in the provision of electronic design and test solutions that are used in the design, development, manufacture, installation, deployment, validation, optimization, and secure operation of electronics systems to communications, networking, and electronics industries. It operates through the Communications Solutions Group (CSG) and Electronic Industrial Solutions Group (EISG) segments. The CSG segment serves customers spanning the global commercial communications and aerospace, defense, and government end markets. The EISG segment offers test and measurement solutions across electronic industrial end markets, focusing on applications in the automotive, and energy industry and measurement solutions for semiconductor design and manufacturing, consumer electronics, education, and general electronics manufacturing. The company was founded by William R. Hewlett and David Packard in 1937 and is headquartered in Santa Rosa, CA.
info.description_zh: 是德科技公司致力於提供電子設計和測試解決方案，這些解決方案用於通訊、網路和電子行業電子系統的設計、開發、製造、安裝、部署、驗證、最佳化和安全操作。它透過通訊解決方案集團（CSG）和電子工業解決方案集團（EISG）部門運作。 CSG 部門為全球商業通訊、航空航太、國防和政府終端市場的客戶提供服務。 EISG 部門提供跨電子工業終端市場的測試和測量解決方案，重點關注汽車和能源產業的應用以及半導體設計和製造、消費性電子、教育和通用電子製造的測量解決方案。該公司由 William R. Hewlett 和 David Packard 於 1937 年創立，總部位於加州聖羅莎。

info.description: Qnity Electronics, Inc. engages in the manufacturing of electronic materials to the semiconductor and electronics industries. Its brands include Acuplane, Circuposit, Duroptix, EPIC, Ikonic, Kalrez, Kapton, Laird, Microfill, Pyralux, Riston, Solderon Tin, and Silveron Silver. Its products include printed circuit board materials, display materials, electrical insulation materials, electronic components, semiconductor fabrication and packaging materials, thermal management materials, general metal finishing, plating on plastics, silver nanowire technologies, and other related products. It operates through the Semiconductor Technologies and Interconnect Solutions segments. The Semiconductor Technologies segment provides a portfolio of innovative materials and solutions utilized across multiple stages of the semiconductor manufacturing process. The Interconnect Solutions segment offers solutions for advanced electronics hardware, including complex printed circuit boards and advanced semiconductor packaging. The company was founded on December 6, 2024 and is headquartered in Wilmington, DE.
info.description_zh: Qnity Electronics, Inc. 從事半導體和電子行業電子材料的製造。其品牌包括 Acuplane、Circuposit、Duroptix、EPIC、Ikonic、Kalrez、Kapton、Laird、Microfill、Pyralux、Riston、Solderon Tin 和 Silveron Silver。其產品包括印刷電路板材料、顯示材料、電氣絕緣材料、電子元件、半導體製造和封裝材料、熱管理材料、一般金屬表面處理、塑膠電鍍、銀奈米線技術和其他相關產品。它透過半導體技術和互連解決方案部門運作。半導體技術部門提供在半導體製造過程的多個階段使用的創新材料和解決方案組合。互連解決方案部門為先進電子硬體提供解決方案，包括複雜的印刷電路板和先進的半導體封裝。該公司成立於2024年12月6日，總部位於德拉瓦州威爾明頓。

info.description: Invesco PHLX Semiconductor ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the PHLX Semiconductor Sector Index . The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. Strictly in accordance with its guidelines and mandated procedures, Nasdaq compiles the underlying index, which is a modified market-capitalization weighted index designed to measure the performance of the 30 largest companies listed in the United States that are engaged in the semiconductor business, as determined by the index Provider. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco PHLX Semiconductor ETF 旨在追蹤 PHLX 半導體產業指數的投資結果（扣除費用和開支之前）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。納斯達克嚴格按照其指導方針和規定程序編制基礎指數，該指數是經過修改的市值加權指數，旨在衡量美國最大的 30 家從事半導體業務的上市公司的業績，由指數提供商確定。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: VanEck Semiconductor ETF seeks to replicate as closely as possible, before fees and expenses, the price and yield performance of the MVIS US Listed Semiconductor 25 Index. The fund normally invests at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the fund's benchmark index. The index includes common stocks and depositary receipts of U.S. exchange-listed companies in the semiconductor industry. Such companies may include medium-capitalization companies and foreign companies that are listed on a U.S. exchange. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: VanEck Semiconductor ETF 尋求盡可能接近複製未計費用和支出之前的 MVIS 美國上市半導體 25 指數的價格和收益率表現。該基金通常將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於構成該基金基準指數的證券。該指數包括美國交易所上市的半導體產業公司的普通股和存託憑證。此類公司可能包括中等資本公司和在美國交易所上市的外國公司。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Ebang International Holdings, Inc. is a blockchain technology company, which engages in the research and development of ASIC chip technology used in blockchain applications in China. It also manufactures bitcoin mining machines. The company was founded by Dong Hu in January 2010 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, China.
info.description_zh: 億邦國際控股有限公司是一家區塊鏈技術公司，在中國從事區塊鏈應用ASIC晶片技術的研發。它还生产比特币采矿机。該公司由胡東於2010年1月創立，總部位於中國杭州。

info.description: iShares Asia 50 ETF seeks to track the investment results of the S&P Asia 50TM composed of 50 of the largest Asian equities. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of its index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of its index and may invest up to 20% of its assets in certain futures, options and swap contracts, cash and cash equivalents. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares Asia 50 ETF 旨在追蹤由 50 隻最大的亞洲股票組成的 S&P Asia 50TM 的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於其指數的組成證券以及具有與其指數組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資，並可能將最多 20% 的資產投資於某些期貨、選擇權和掉期合約、現金和現金等價物。它是非多元化的。

info.description: First Trust S-Network Future Vehicles & Technology ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the S-Network Electric & Future Vehicle Ecosystem Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets in the common stocks and depositary receipts that comprise the index. To be eligible for inclusion in the index, a company must be listed on a major recognized stock exchange and engaged in one of the following sectors: electric and autonomous vehicle manufacturing; enabling technologies or enabling materials. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: First Trust S-Network 未來車輛和技術 ETF 尋求的投資結果通常與名為 S-Network 電動和未來車輛生態系統指數的股票指數的價格和收益率（基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產投資於構成該指數的普通股和存託憑證。為了有資格納入該指數，公司必須在主要認可的證券交易所上市，並從事以下行業之一：電動和自動駕駛汽車製造；使能技術或使能材料。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: TuHURA Biosciences, Inc. is a clinical-stage immuno-oncology company, which engages in the development of novel technologies to overcome resistance to cancer immunotherapy. Its lead product candidate, IFx2.0, is an innate immune agonist designed to overcome primary resistance to checkpoint inhibitors. The company was founded by Michael Lawman, Patricia Lawman and James A. Bianco on May 4, 2023 and is headquartered in Tampa, FL.
info.description_zh: TuHURA Biosciences, Inc.是一家臨床階段的免疫腫瘤學公司，致力於開發克服癌症免疫療法抗藥性的新技術。其主要候選產品 IFx2.0 是一種先天免疫激動劑，旨在克服對檢查點抑制劑的主要抗藥性。該公司由 Michael Lawman、Patricia Lawman 和 James A. Bianco 於 2023 年 5 月 4 日創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州坦帕。

info.description: Xtrackers Semiconductor Select Equity ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the performance, before fees and expenses, of the Solactive Semiconductor ESG Screened Index. The fund, using a "passive" or indexing investment approach, seeks investment results that correspond generally to the performance, before fees and expenses, of the underlying index, which is comprised of companies that have business operations in the semiconductor industry and that fulfill certain sustainability criteria. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Xtrackers Semiconductor Select Equity ETF 尋求與 Solactive Semiconductor ESG 篩選指數的績效（未計費用和開支）大致相符的投資結果。該基金採用「被動」或指數投資方法，尋求與相關指數（未計費用和開支）的表現大致相對應的投資結果，該指數由在半導體行業開展業務並滿足某些可持續性標準的公司組成。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Golden Eagle Dynamic Hypergrowth ETF seeks capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing, under normal market conditions, at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the common stock of "hypergrowth companies.
info.description_zh: Golden Eagle Dynamic Hypergrowth ETF 尋求資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金，旨在透過在正常市場條件下將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於「高速成長公司」的普通股來實現其投資目標。

info.description: Micron Technology, Inc. engages in the provision of innovative memory and storage solutions. It operates through the following segments: Compute and Networking Business Unit (CNBU), Mobile Business Unit (MBU), Embedded Business Unit (EBU), and Storage Business Unit (SBU). The CNBU segment includes memory products and solutions sold into client, cloud server, enterprise, graphics, and networking markets. The MBU segment is involved in memory and storage products sold into smartphone and other mobile-device markets. The EBU segment focuses on memory and storage products sold into automotive, industrial, and consumer Markets. The SBU segment consists of SSDs and component-level solutions sold into enterprise and cloud, client, and consumer storage markets. The company was founded by Ward D. Parkinson, Joseph Leon Parkinson, Dennis Wilson, and Doug Pitman on October 5, 1978 and is headquartered in Boise, ID.
info.description_zh: Micron Technology, Inc. 致力於提供創新的記憶體和儲存解決方案。它透過以下部門運作：運算和網路業務部門（CNBU）、行動業務部門（MBU）、嵌入式業務部門（EBU）和儲存業務部門（SBU）。 CNBU 部門包括銷售給客戶端、雲端伺服器、企業、圖形和網路市場的記憶體產品和解決方案。 MBU 部門涉及銷往智慧型手機和其他行動裝置市場的記憶體和儲存產品。 EBU 部門專注於銷往汽車、工業和消費市場的記憶體和儲存產品。 SBU 部門包括企業和雲端、用戶端和消費者儲存市場銷售的 SSD 和組件級解決方案。該公司由 Ward D. Parkinson、Joseph Leon Parkinson、Dennis Wilson 和 Doug Pitman 於 1978 年 10 月 5 日創立，總部位於愛達荷州博伊西。

info.description: Sagtec Global Ltd. provides IT consulting, software and mobile app development and cloud computing services. It focuses on customizable software solutions encompassing several types of software such as a smart ordering system, Speed +, smart solutions application software for the food and beverage industry. The company was founded on October 31, 2023 and is headquartered in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
info.description_zh: Sagtec Global Ltd. 提供 IT 諮詢、軟體和行動應用程式開發以及雲端運算服務。它專注於可自訂的軟體解決方案，涵蓋多種類型的軟體，例如智慧訂購系統、Speed +、食品和飲料行業的智慧解決方案應用軟體。該公司成立於2023年10月31日，總部位於馬來西亞吉隆坡。

info.description: Global X AI Semiconductor & Quantum ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Global X AI Semiconductor & Quantum Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets, plus borrowings for investment purposes, in the securities of the underlying index), which may include common stocks, ADRs and GDRs. The underlying index, as presently constituted, is designed to track the performance of companies that are involved in the artificial intelligence ("AI") semiconductor and quantum computing ecosystems. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X AI 半導體和量子 ETF 尋求提供與 Global X AI 半導體和量子指數未計費用和開支前的價格和收益率表現大致相對應的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於相關指數的證券，其中可能包括普通股、ADR 和 GDR。目前構成的基礎指數旨在追蹤參與人工智慧（「AI」）半導體和量子運算生態系統的公司的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Hyperion DeFi, Inc. is a long-term strategic treasury of Hyperliquid's native token HYPE. The firm provides investors with streamlined access to the Hyperliquid ecosystem and is also developing its proprietary Optejet user-filled device, designed for use with a variety of topical ophthalmic liquids, including artificial tears and lens rewetting products. It operates through the following segments: Ophthalmic Technology and Digital Assets. The Ophthalmic Technology segment focuses on developing eye-care devices and delivery systems for ophthalmic liquids. The Digital Assets segment focuses on managing a strategic treasury of blockchain-based assets and exposure to the Hyperliquid ecosystem. The company was founded by Sean Ianchulev on March 12, 2014 and is headquartered in Laguna Hills, CA.
info.description_zh: Hyperion DeFi, Inc. 是 Hyperliquid 原生代幣 HYPE 的長期策略金庫。該公司為投資者提供了進入 Hyperliquid 生態系統的簡化途徑，並且還在開發其專有的 Optejet 用戶填充設備，該設備設計用於各種局部眼科液體，包括人工淚液和鏡片再潤濕產品。它透過以下部門運作：眼科技術部門和數位資產部門。眼科技術部門專注於開發眼科護理設備和眼科液體輸送系統。數位資產部門專注於管理基於區塊鏈的資產的策略金庫以及對 Hyperliquid 生態系統的投資。該公司由 Sean Ianchulev 於 2014 年 3 月 12 日創立，總部位於加利福尼亞州拉古納山。

info.description: Texas Instruments Incorporated engages in the design and manufacture of semiconductors. It operates through the following segments: Analog, Embedded Processing, and Other. The Analog segment semiconductors change real-world signals, such as sound, temperature, pressure or images, by conditioning them, amplifying them and often converting them to a stream of digital data that can be processed by other semiconductors, such as embedded processors. The Embedded Processing segment involves handling specific tasks and can be optimized for various combinations of performance, power, and cost, depending on the application. The Other segment includes DLP products, calculators, and custom application-specific integrated circuits products. The company was founded in 1930 and is headquartered in Dallas, TX.
info.description_zh: 德州儀器公司從事半導體的設計和製造。它透過以下部分運作：模擬、嵌入式處理和其他。類比部分半導體透過調節、放大並通常將它們轉換為可由其他半導體（例如嵌入式處理器）處理的數位資料流來改變現實世界的訊號，例如聲音、溫度、壓力或影像。嵌入式處理部分涉及處理特定任務，並且可以根據應用程式針對效能、功耗和成本的各種組合進行最佳化。其他部分包括 DLP 產品、計算器和客製化專用積體電路產品。該公司成立於 1930 年，總部位於德克薩斯州達拉斯。

info.description: Hallador Energy Co. engages in business through its subsidiary, Sunrise Coal, LLC, which produces coal in the Illinois Basin for the electric power generation industry. It also owns summit terminal, a transport facility on the Ohio River. The company was founded in 1951 and is headquartered in Terre Haute, IN.
info.industry_zh: 公用事業 - 獨立電力生產商
info.description_zh: Hallador Energy Co. 透過其子公司 Sunrise Coal, LLC 從事業務，該公司在伊利諾伊州盆地生產用於發電行業的煤炭。它還擁有山頂碼頭，這是俄亥俄河上的一個交通設施。該公司成立於 1951 年，總部位於印第安納州特雷霍特。

info.description: Jowell Global Ltd. operates as a holding company, which engages in the provision of cosmetics, health and nutritional supplements, and household products through its e-commerce platform. It offers lotions, oral care, shampoo, soap, fragrance, vitamins, edible fungus, functional capsules, shoes, smartphones, cooking pot, and tampons. The company was founded on August 16, 2019 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
info.description_zh: Jowell Global Ltd. operates as a holding company, which engages in the provision of cosmetics, health and nutritional supplements, and household products through its e-commerce platform. It offers lotions, oral care, through its e-commerce platform. It , foters lotions, oral care, through its e-commerce platform, s, f5, functional, functional, f片, functional. shoes, smartphones, cooking pot, and tampons.公司成立于2019年8月16日，总部位于中国上海。

info.description: SharonAI Holdings, Inc. operates as a holding company that develops and delivers GPU cloud computing and AI solutions. The company was founded on December 30, 2024 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: SharonAI Holdings, Inc. 作為一家控股公司經營，開發和提供 GPU 雲端運算和人工智慧解決方案。該公司成立於2024年12月30日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: J.W. Mays, Inc. engages in the operation of commercial real estate properties. The company was founded in 1924 and is headquartered in Brooklyn, NY.
info.description_zh: J.W. Mays, Inc. 從事商業房地產的營運。該公司成立於 1924 年，總部位於紐約布魯克林。

info.description: Vertiv Holdings Co. engages in the design, manufacture, and service of critical digital infrastructure technology for data centers, communication networks, and commercial and industrial environments. The firm also offers power management products, switchgear and busbar products, thermal management products, integrated rack systems, modular solutions, and management systems for monitoring and controlling digital infrastructure. It operates through the following geographical segments: Americas, Asia Pacific, and Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EMEA). The Americas segment includes products and services sold for applications within the data center, communication networks and commercial and industrial markets in North America and Latin America. The Asia Pacific segment consists of products and services sold for applications within the data center, communication networks and commercial and industrial markets throughout Greater China, Asia, and India. The EMEA segment focuses on products and services sold for applications within the data center, communication networks, and commercial and industrial markets in Europe, Middle East, and Africa. The company was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in Westerville, OH.
info.description_zh: Vertiv Holdings Co. 從事資料中心、通訊網路以及商業和工業環境的關鍵數位基礎設施技術的設計、製造和服務。該公司還提供電源管理產品、開關設備和母線產品、熱管理產品、整合式機架系統、模組化解決方案以及用於監視和控制數位基礎設施的管理系統。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美洲、亞太地區以及歐洲、中東和非洲 (EMEA)。美洲部門包括為北美和拉丁美洲的資料中心、通訊網路以及商業和工業市場內的應用程式銷售的產品和服務。亞太地區業務包括為大中華區、亞洲和印度的資料中心、通訊網路以及商業和工業市場內的應用程式銷售的產品和服務。 EMEA 部門專注於為歐洲、中東和非洲的資料中心、通訊網路以及商業和工業市場內的應用程式銷售的產品和服務。該公司成立於 1946 年，總部位於俄亥俄州韋斯特維爾。

info.description: Tower Semiconductor Ltd. engages in providing semiconductor solutions. It also offers technology and manufacturing platforms for integrated circuits (ICs) in growing markets such as consumer, industrial, automotive, mobile, infrastructure, medical, and aerospace and defense. It focuses on creating positive and sustainable impact on the world through long term partnerships and its advanced and innovative analog technology offering, comprised of a broad range of customizable process platforms such as SiGe, BiCMOS, mixed-signal/CMOS, RF CMOS, CMOS image sensor, non-imaging sensors, integrated power management (BCD and 700V), and MEMS. Its designs enable a quick and accurate design cycle as well as process transfer services including development, transfer, and optimization, to IDMs and fabless companies. The company was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Migdal Haemek, Israel.
info.description_zh: Tower Semiconductor Ltd. 致力於提供半導體解決方案。它還為消費、工業、汽車、移動、基礎設施、醫療、航空航太和國防等不斷增長的市場中的積體電路 (IC) 提供技術和製造平台。它專注於透過長期合作夥伴關係及其先進和創新的類比技術產品對世界產生積極和可持續的影響，該技術產品由廣泛的可自訂製程平台組成，例如 SiGe、BiCMOS、混合訊號/CMOS、RF CMOS、CMOS 影像感測器、非影像感測器、整合電源管理（BCD 和 700V）和 MEMS。其設計為 IDM 和無晶圓廠公司提供快速、準確的設計週期以及包括開發、轉移和優化在內的流程轉移服務。該公司成立於1993年，總部位於以色列Migdal Haemek。

info.description: EquipmentShare.com, Inc. is a digitally-native equipment rental platform servicing the largest jobsites nationwide. It operates through the following segments: Equipment Rental and Services Operations, and Equipment Sales. The Equipment Rental and Services Operations segment engages in recurring activities at full-service branch locations, including equipment rentals and related services, as well as the sale of parts, supplies, and maintenance services. The Equipment Sales segment engages in the sale of new and used equipment through branch locations and dealership sites, including sales to participants in the OWN Program. The company was founded by Jabbok Schlacks and William J. Schlacks IV in 2014 and is headquartered in Columbia, MO.
info.description_zh: EquipmentShare.com, Inc. 是一個數位原生設備租賃平台，為全國最大的工作場所提供服務。它透過以下部門運作：設備租賃和服務營運以及設備銷售。設備租賃和服務營運部門在全方位服務分公司從事經常性活動，包括設備租賃和相關服務，以及零件、用品和維護服務的銷售。設備銷售部門透過分公司和經銷商站點從事新設備和二手設備的銷售，包括向 OWN 計畫參與者的銷售。該公司由 Jabbok Schlacks 和 William J. Schlacks IV 於 2014 年創立，總部位於密蘇裡州哥倫比亞。

info.description: Cue Biopharma, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development of immunotherapies to treat cancer and autoimmune diseases. Its products include CUE-400 series (autoimmune diseases), CUE-500 series (targeted cell depletion), and CUE-100 series (Oncology). The company was founded by Ronald D. Seidel III, Steven Almo, and Rodolfo Chaparro on December 31, 2014 and is headquartered in Boston, MA.
info.description_zh: Cue Biopharma, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於開發治療癌症和自體免疫疾病的免疫療法。其產品包括CUE-400系列（自體免疫疾病）、CUE-500系列（靶向細胞去除）和CUE-100系列（腫瘤）。該公司由 Ronald D. Seidel III、Steven Almo 和 Rodolfo Chaparro 於 2014 年 12 月 31 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州波士頓。

info.description: Arm Holdings Plc engages in the licensing, marketing, research, and development of microprocessors, systems IP, graphics processing units, physical IP and associated systems IP, software, and tools. It operates through the following geographical segments: United Kingdom, United States, and Other Countries. The company was founded on November 12, 1990 and is headquartered in Cambridge, the United Kingdom.
info.description_zh: Arm Holdings Plc 從事微處理器、系統 IP、圖形處理單元、實體 IP 和相關係統 IP、軟體和工具的授權、行銷、研究和開發。它透過以下地理區域運作：英國、美國和其他國家。該公司成立於1990年11月12日，總部位於英國劍橋。

info.description: YY Group Holding Ltd. operates as an AI-native workforce management platform, which engages in providing integrated facility management (IFM). Its platform, YY Circle, offers solutions for hospitality, food and beverage, retail, and other service sectors to predict, plan, and optimize workforce deployment. The company was founded by Fu Xiao Wei and Zhang Fan in December 2010 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: YY Group Holding Ltd. 是一家人工智慧原生勞動力管理平台，致力於提供全面設施管理（IFM）。其平台 YY Circle 為飯店、餐飲、零售和其他服務業提供解決方案，以預測、規劃和優化勞動力部署。該公司由付曉偉和張帆於2010年12月創立，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Garden Stage Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of placing and underwriting services. It also offers securities dealing and brokerage and asset management services. The company was founded on August 11, 2022 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: Garden Stage Ltd.是一家控股公司，從事提供配售及包銷服務。它還提供證券交易、經紀和資產管理服務。該公司成立於2022年8月11日，總部位於香港。

info.description: GraniteShares 2x Long VRT Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of Vertiv Holdings Co. The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to replicate 2 times (200%) daily percentage change of the underlying stock by entering financial instruments such as swaps and options on the underlying stock as well as directly purchasing the underlying stock. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 2x Long VRT Daily ETF 尋求未計費用和開支的每日投資結果為 Vertiv Holdings Co. 普通股每日百分比變化的 2 倍 (200%)。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金，試圖透過輸入標的股票掉期和選擇權等金融工具以及直接購買標的股票來複製標的股票每日百分比變化的 2 倍 (200%)。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Direxion Daily MU Bull 2X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of MU. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of MU and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 2X daily leveraged exposure to MU, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily MU Bull 2X Shares 尋求 MU 每日表現的 200% 的每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 MU 的證券和金融工具，例如掉期協議和選擇權，這些組合起來為 MU 提供 2 倍的每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: GraniteShares 2x Long MU Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of Micron Technology Inc. (NASDAQ: MU). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to replicate 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the underlying stock by entering into financial instruments such as swaps and options on the underlying stock as well as directly purchasing the underlying stock. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 2x Long MU Daily ETF 尋求每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為美光科技公司（納斯達克股票代碼：MU）普通股每日百分比變化的 2 倍（200%）。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金，試圖透過進入標的股票的掉期和選擇權等金融工具以及直接購買標的股票來複製標的股票每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: FG Merger II Corp. is a blank check company formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on September 20, 2023 and is headquartered in Itasca, IL.
info.description_zh: FG Merger II Corp. 是一家空白支票公司，其成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於 2023 年 9 月 20 日，總部位於伊利諾伊州艾塔斯卡。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long ARM Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of ARM. The fund is an actively managed ETF. It invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of ARM, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 ARM 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 ARM 價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。它將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來可提供 ARM 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Defiance Daily Target 2X Short SMCI ETF seeks daily inverse investment results, before fees and expenses, of -2 times (-200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of Super Micro Computer, Inc. (Nasdaq: SMCI) and the fund does not seek to achieve its stated investment objective for a period other than a single trading day. The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to achieve 2 times the inverse (-200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the underlying security by employing derivatives, namely swap agreements and/or listed options contracts. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance Daily Target 2X Short SMCI ETF 尋求每日反向投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 Super Micro Computer, Inc.（納斯達克股票代碼：SMCI）每日股價變化百分比的 -2 倍（-200%），並且該基金不尋求在單一交易日以外的期間實現其既定投資目標。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金，試圖透過採用衍生性商品（即掉期協議和/或上市選擇權合約）來實現標的證券價格每日百分比變化的 2 倍倒數（-200%）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: IceCure Medical Ltd. engages in the development and marketing of therapy for the treatment of tumors. Its product, ProSense Cryoablation System, provides invasive treatment option to destroy tumors by freezing them. The company was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Caesarea, Israel.
info.description_zh: IceCure Medical Ltd. 從事腫瘤治療藥物的開發和行銷。其產品 ProSense 冷凍消融系統提供侵入性治療選擇，透過冷凍來破壞腫瘤。該公司成立於2006年，總部位於以色列凱撒利亞。

info.description: Boxlight Corp. is a technological company, which engages in development, sale, and servicing of interactive solutions for the global education market. It also designs, manufactures, and distributes interactive projectors, flat-panel displays, touch projectors, touch boards, and MimioTeach through the Boxlight Group and Genesis brands. The company was founded by Herbert Myers and Sloan Myers in 1985 and is headquartered in Duluth, GA.
info.description_zh: Boxlight Corp. 是一家科技公司，致力於為全球教育市場提供互動式解決方案的開發、銷售和服務。它还通过 Boxlight Group 和 Genesis 品牌设计、制造和分销交互式投影仪、平板显示器、触摸投影仪、触摸板和 MimioTeach。該公司由 Herbert Myers 和 Sloan Myers 於 1985 年創立，總部位於喬治亞州德盧斯。

info.description: Eshallgo, Inc. operates as a holding company, which through its subsidiaries and controlled entities engages in the sale and lease of office equipment and related maintenance services. The company was founded by Zhi Dan Mao and Qi Wei Miao in 2015 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
info.description_zh: Eshallgo, Inc. 作為控股公司運營，透過其子公司和受控實體從事辦公設備的銷售和租賃以及相關維護服務。該公司由毛志丹和苗齊偉於2015年創立，總部位於中國上海。

info.description: Mama's Creations, Inc. engages in the marketing, manufacturing, and distribution of fresh deli-prepared foods. The firm's products include beef meatballs, turkey meatballs, stuffed meatballs, lasagna roll ups, retail ready meals, bulk deli, single-size pasta bowls, and packaged refrigerated products. Its brands include MamaMancini's, Crown 1, Creative Salads, and The Olive Branch. The company was founded by Daniel Dougherty and Daniel Mancini on July 22, 2009 and is headquartered in East Rutherford, NJ.
info.description_zh: Mama's Creations, Inc. 從事新鮮熟食食品的營銷、製造和分銷。該公司的產品包括牛肉丸、火雞肉丸、釀肉丸、烤寬麵條捲、零售即食食品、散裝熟食店、單一尺寸義大利麵碗和包裝冷藏產品。其品牌包括 MamaMancini's、Crown 1、Creative Salads 和 The Olive Branch。該公司由 Daniel Dougherty 和 Daniel Mancini 於 2009 年 7 月 22 日創立，總部位於新澤西州東盧瑟福。

info.description: Churchill Capital Corp. XI is a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded by Michael Stuart Klein on June 4, 2025 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Churchill Capital Corp. XI 是一家空白支票公司。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司由 Michael Stuart Klein 於 2025 年 6 月 4 日創立，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Lifeway Foods, Inc. engages in the manufacture of probiotic and nutritious foods. The firm's products include kefir, organic kefir, probiotic smoothie with collagen, muscle mates, probugs, and cheese. It distributes its products primarily through its direct sales force, brokers, and distributors. The company was founded by Michael Smolyansky and Ludmila Smolyansky in February 1986 and is headquartered in Morton Grove, IL.
info.description_zh: Lifeway Foods, Inc. 從事益生菌和營養食品的製造。該公司的產品包括克菲爾、有機克菲爾、含膠原蛋白的益生菌冰沙、肌肉伴侶、益生菌和起司。它主要透過其直銷隊伍、經紀人和分銷商分銷其產品。該公司由 Michael Smolyansky 和 ​​Ludmila Smolyansky 於 1986 年 2 月創立，總部位於伊利諾伊州莫頓格羅夫。

info.description: Fluent, Inc. engages in the provision of digital marketing services. It operates through the following segments: Fluent, Call Solutions, and AdParlor. The Fluent segment includes delivering data and performance-based marketing executions. The company was founded by Ryan Schulke and Matthew Conlin in 2001 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Fluent, Inc. 從事提供數位行銷服務。它透過以下部門運作：Fluent、Call Solutions 和 AdParlor。 Fluent 部分包括提供數據和基於績效的行銷執行。該公司由 Ryan Schulke 和 Matthew Conlin 於 2001 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Solid Biosciences, Inc. is a life science company, which engages in the development of treatments for patients with Duchenne muscular dystrophy. It also focuses on developing treatments for neuromuscular and cardiac diseases. The company was founded by Ilan Ganot, Andrey J. Zarur, Matthew Bennett Arnold, Annie Ganot, and Gilad David Hayeem in March 2013 and is headquartered in Charlestown, MA.
info.description_zh: Solid Biosciences, Inc.是一家生命科學公司，致力於開發杜氏肌肉營養不良症患者的治療方法。它還專注於開發神經肌肉和心臟病的治療方法。該公司由 Ilan Ganot、Andrey J. Zarur、Matthew Bennett Arnold、Annie Ganot 和 Gilad David Hayeem 於 2013 年 3 月創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州查爾斯敦。

info.description: Monopar Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in developing proprietary therapeutics for cancer patients. It also focuses on building a drug development pipeline through the licensing, and acquisition of therapeutics in late preclinical and clinical development stages. The company was founded by Chandler Drew Robinson, Christopher M. Starr and Andrew P. Mazar in December 2014 and is headquartered in Wilmette, IL.
info.description_zh: Monopar Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段生物製藥公司，致力於為癌症患者開發專有療法。它還專注於透過許可以及在臨床前和臨床開發後期階段獲取治療藥物來建立藥物開發管道。該公司由 Chandler Drew Robinson、Christopher M. Starr 和 Andrew P. Mazar 於 2014 年 12 月創立，總部位於伊利諾州威爾梅特。

info.description: BranchOut Food, Inc. engages in the development, marketing, sale, and distribution of plant-based, dehydrated fruit, and vegetable snacks and powders. Its products include pineapple chips, chewy banana bites, crunchy strawberry halves, bell pepper crisps, and carrot sticks. The company was founded by Eric Healy and David Israel on February 21, 2017 and is headquartered in Bend, OR.
info.description_zh: BranchOut Food, Inc. 從事植物性脫水水果和蔬菜零食及粉末的開發、行銷、銷售和分銷。其產品包括鳳梨片、耐嚼香蕉片、脆脆草莓片、甜椒片和胡蘿蔔條。該公司由 Eric Healy 和 David Israel 於 2017 年 2 月 21 日創立，總部位於俄勒岡州本德。

info.description: Focus Universal, Inc. engages in the development and manufacture of universal smart devices. Its technology features a Universal Smart Instrumentation Platform (USIP), a hardware and software integration platform that provides solutions for embedded design, industrial control and monitoring. It also offers Ubiquitor, universal smart controller, and sensors. The company was founded by Desheng Wang on December 4, 2012 and is headquartered in West Covina, CA.
info.description_zh: Focus Universal, Inc.從事通用智慧型裝置的開發與製造。其技術採用通用智慧儀器平台（USIP），這是一個硬體和軟體整合平台，為嵌入式設計、工業控制和監控提供解決方案。它還提供 Ubiquitor、通用智慧控制器和感測器。該公司由王德勝於2012年12月4日創立，總部位於加州西科維納。

info.description: Aveanna Healthcare Holdings, Inc. engages in providing home care services to patients. It operates through the following business segments: Private Duty Services (PDS), Home Health & Hospice (HHH), and Medical Solutions (MS). The PDS segment includes private duty nursing services. The HHH segment provides home health, hospice, and program services to predominately elderly populations. The MS segment offers supplies to patients requiring enteral nutrition services or respiratory care. The company was founded on November 30, 2016 and is headquartered in Atlanta, GA.
info.description_zh: Aveanna Healthcare Holdings, Inc. 致力於為患者提供家庭護理服務。該公司透過以下業務部門運作：私人值班服務 (PDS)、家庭健康和臨終關懷 (HHH) 以及醫療解決方案 (MS)。 PDS 部門包括私人護理服務。 HHH 部門主要為老年人提供家庭健康、臨終關懷和計畫服務。 MS 部門為需要腸內營養服務或呼吸照護的患者提供用品。該公司成立於2016年11月30日，總部位於喬治亞州亞特蘭大。

info.description: InterGroup Corp. engages in the purchasing, development, operation, rehabilitation, and disposal of real property of various types and descriptions. It operates through the following business segments: Hotel Operations, Real Estate Operations, Investment Transactions, and Other. The Hotel Operations segment handles the business activities of hotels. The Real Estate Operations segment refers to the multi-family residential properties. The Investment Transactions segment represents the investment of the company's cash in marketable securities and other investments. The company was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Los Angeles, CA.
info.description_zh: InterGroup Corp. 從事各種類型和種類的不動產的購買、開發、營運、修復和處置。它透過以下業務部門運作：酒店營運、房地產營運、投資交易和其他。飯店營運部門負責飯店的業務活動。房地產營運部門是指多戶住宅物業。投資交易部門代表公司現金對有價證券和其他投資的投資。該公司成立於 1985 年，總部位於加州洛杉磯。

info.description: Mirum Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company. The firm focuses on the development and commercialization of a late-stage pipeline of novel therapies for debilitating liver diseases. Its products include Maralixibat and Volixibat. The company was founded by Niall O'Donnel, Michael Grey and Christopher Peetz in May 2018 and is headquartered in Foster City, CA.
info.description_zh: Mirum Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司。該公司專注於治療衰弱性肝病的後期新療法的開發和商業化。其產品包括Maralixibat和Volixibat。該公司由 Niall O'Donnel、Michael Gray 和 Christopher Peetz 於 2018 年 5 月創立，總部位於加州福斯特城。

info.description: Benitec Biopharma, Inc. is a development-stage biotechnology company, which engages in the advancement of novel genetic medicines. The firm's proprietary platforms include DNA-directed RNA interference, or ddRNAi, combines RNA interference, or RNAi, with gene therapy to create medicines that facilitates sustained silencing of disease-causing genes following a single administration. It is developing ddRNAi-based therapeutics for chronic and life-threatening human conditions including Oculopharyngeal Muscular Dystrophy and Chronic Hepatitis B. The company was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Hayward, CA.
info.description_zh: Benitec Biopharma, Inc. 是一家處於開發階段的生物技術公司，致力於新型基因藥物的開發。該公司的專有平台包括 DNA 引導的 RNA 幹擾（ddRNAi），將 RNA 幹擾（RNAi）與基因療法結合，創造出單次給藥後可促進致病基因持續沉默的藥物。該公司正在開發基於 ddRNAi 的療法，用於治療慢性和危及生命的人類疾病，包括眼咽肌肉營養不良症和慢性乙型肝炎。該公司成立於 1995 年，總部位於加州海沃德。

info.description: Willis Lease Finance Corp. engages in the provision of aviation services and operating leases of commercial aircraft, aircraft engines, and other aircraft-related equipment to air carriers, manufacturers, and overhaul/repair facilities. It operates through the Leasing and Related Operations, and Spare Parts Sales. The Leasing and Related Operations segment acquires and leases commercial aircraft and aircraft engines, and the selective purchase and resale of commercial aircraft engines and other aircraft equipment and other related businesses. The Spare Parts Sales segment includes the purchase and resale of after-market engine parts, whole engines, engine modules, and portable aircraft components. The company was founded by Charles F. Willis, IV in 1985 and is headquartered in Coconut Creek, FL.
info.description_zh: Willis Lease Finance Corp. 從事向航空公司、製造商和大修/維修設施提供航空服務以及商用飛機、飛機發動機和其他飛機相關設備的營業租賃。它透過租賃和相關業務以及備件銷售進行營運。租賃及相關業務部門收購和租賃商用飛機和飛機發動機，以及選擇性購買和轉售商用飛機發動機和其他飛機設備及其他相關業務。備件銷售部門包括售後發動機零件、整個發動機、發動機模組和便攜式飛機部件的購買和轉售。該公司由 Charles F. Willis, IV 於 1985 年創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州椰子溪。

info.description: Deswell Industries, Inc. engages in the manufacture and sale of injection-molded plastic parts and components, electrical products and subassemblies and metallic molds and accessories. It operates through the Plastic Injection Molding and Electronic Products Assembling segments. The Plastic Injection Molding segment includes plastic components for electric entertainment products; cases for flashlights, telephones, projectors, and alarm clocks; toner cartridges, and cases for photocopiers and printers; parts for audio equipment; medical testing equipment; and automobile components. The Electronic Products Assembling segment produces equipment used in sports stadiums, concert halls, recording studios, and radio and television stations. The company was founded in 1987 and is headquartered in Macao, China.
info.description_zh: Deswell Industries, Inc. 從事注塑塑膠零件、電氣產品和組件以及金屬模具和配件的製造和銷售。它透過塑膠注塑和電子產品組裝部門運作。塑膠射出成型部門包括用於電子娛樂產品的塑膠零件；手電筒、電話、投影機和鬧鐘的盒子；影印機和印表機的墨粉盒、外殼；音響設備零件；醫療檢測設備；和汽車零件。電子產品組裝部門生產體育場館、音樂廳、錄音室以及廣播電台和電視台使用的設備。該公司成立於1987年，總部位於中國澳門。

info.description: Entera Bio Ltd. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development and commercialization of orally delivered large molecule therapeutics. It s pipeline include PTH(1-34), GLP-1 and GLP-2. The company was founded on September 30, 2009 and is headquartered in Jerusalem, Israel.
info.description_zh: Entera Bio Ltd.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，從事口服大分子治療藥物的開發和商業化。其管線包括PTH(1-34)、GLP-1和GLP-2。該公司成立於2009年9月30日，總部位於以色列耶路撒冷。

info.description: Wearable Devices Ltd. engages in the development of a non-invasive neural input technology that allows operation and control of digital devices using subtle finger movements and fingertip pressure. It offers Mudra band, a neutral input wristband. The company was founded by Asher Dahan, Guy Wagner, and Leeor Langer in March 2014 and is headquartered in Yokne'am Illit, Israel.
info.description_zh: Wearable Devices Ltd. 致力於開發非侵入性神經輸入技術，該技術允許使用微妙的手指運動和指尖壓力來操作和控制數位設備。它提供 Mudra Band，一種中性輸入腕帶。該公司由 Asher Dahan、Guy Wagner 和 Leeor Langer 於 2014 年 3 月創立，總部位於以色列 Yokne'am Illit。

info.description: John B. Sanfilippo & Son, Inc. engages in the processing and distribution of nuts and nut-related products. It offers peanuts, pecans, cashews, walnuts, almonds, and other nuts under the brands of Fisher, Orchard Valley Harvest, Squirrel Brand, and Southern Style Nuts. The company was founded by Gaspare Sanfilippo and John B. Sanfilippo in 1922 and is headquartered in Elgin, IL.
info.description_zh: John B. Sanfilippo & Son, Inc. 從事堅果及堅果相關產品的加工和分銷。該公司提供 Fisher、Orchard Valley Harvest、Squirrel Brand 和 Southern Style Nuts 品牌的花生、山核桃、腰果、核桃、杏仁和其他堅果。該公司由 Gaspare Sanfilippo 和 John B. Sanfilippo 於 1922 年創立，總部位於伊利諾伊州埃爾金。

info.description: Xencor, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development of engineered monoclonal antibody therapeutics to treat severe and life-threatening diseases. Its proprietary technology platform, XmAb, is used to create next-generation antibody product candidates designed to treat autoimmune and allergic diseases, cancer, and other conditions. The company was founded by Bassil I. Dahiyat and Stephen L. Mayo in August 1997 and is headquartered in Pasadena, CA.
info.description_zh: Xencor, Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司，致力於開發工程單株抗體療法來治療嚴重和危及生命的疾病。其專有技術平台 XmAb 用於創建下一代候選抗體產品，旨在治療自體免疫疾病和過敏性疾病、癌症和其他疾病。該公司由 Bassil I. Dahiyat 和 Stephen L. Mayo 於 1997 年 8 月創立，總部位於加州帕薩迪納。

info.description: Backblaze, Inc. operates as a cloud provider for businesses and consumers to store, use, and protect their data. The firm, through its storage cloud platform, provides a foundation for businesses, developers, IT professionals, and individuals to store, backup, and archive data, host content, manage media, and build their applications. It also offers B2 Cloud Storage and Computer Backup services. The company was founded by Timothy Nufire, Gleb Budman, Charles Jones, Kwok Hang Ng and Brian Wilson in 2007 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Backblaze, Inc. 是一家雲端供應商，為企業和消費者儲存、使用和保護他們的資料。該公司透過其儲存雲平台，為企業、開發人員、IT 專業人員和個人提供儲存、備份和歸檔資料、託管內容、管理媒體和建立應用程式的基礎。它還提供 B2 雲端儲存和電腦備份服務。該公司由 Timothy Nufire、Gleb Budman、Charles Jones、Kwok Hang Ng 和 Brian Wilson 於 2007 年創立，總部位於加州舊金山。

info.description: Catalyst Bancorp, Inc. operates as a bank holding company. It provides savings and loan banking services through its subsidiary, Catalyst Bank. The company was founded in 1922 and is headquartered in Opelousas, LA.
info.description_zh: Catalyst Bancorp, Inc. 以銀行控股公司營運。它透過其子公司 Catalyst Bank 提供儲蓄和貸款銀行服務。該公司成立於 1922 年，總部位於路易斯安那州奧佩盧薩斯。

info.description: The Bancorp, Inc. is a financial holding company, which engages in the provision of private label banking and financial services through the Bank. It operates through the following segments: Fintech Solutions and Credit Solutions. The Fintech Solutions segment delivers payment, deposit, and lending products that attract deposits and generate fee income. The Credit Solutions segment engages in the provision of lending services, including real estate bridge lending, institutional banking products such as SBLOCs and IBLOCs, advisor financing, and commercial loans including small business and lease financing. The company was founded by Betzy Z. Cohen on July 20, 1999 and is headquartered in Wilmington, DE.
info.description_zh: The Bancorp, Inc. 是一家金融控股公司，透過銀行提供自有品牌銀行和金融服務。它透過以下部門運作：金融科技解決方案和信貸解決方案。金融科技解決方案部門提供支付、存款和貸款產品，吸引存款並產生費用收入。信貸解決方案部門提供貸款服務，包括房地產過橋貸款、SBLOC 和 IBLOC 等機構銀行產品、顧問融資以及包括小型企業和租賃融資在內的商業貸款。該公司由 Betzy Z. Cohen 於 1999 年 7 月 20 日創立，總部位於特拉華州威爾明頓。

info.description: Savara, Inc. is a clinical-stage pharmaceutical company, which engages in the development and commercialization of novel therapies for the treatment of serious or life-threatening rare respiratory diseases. Its program includes molgramostim, which is an inhaled formulation of recombinant human GM-CSF and being developed for the treatment of autoimmune pulmonary alveolar proteinosis. The company was founded in December 1995 and is headquartered in Langhorne, PA.
info.description_zh: Savara, Inc. 是一家臨床階段製藥公司，致力於治療嚴重或危及生命的罕見呼吸道疾病的新療法的開發和商業化。其項目包括molgramostim，這是一種重組人類GM-CSF的吸入製劑，正在開發用於治療自體免疫性肺泡蛋白沉積症。該公司成立於 1995 年 12 月，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州蘭霍恩。

info.description: Capital City Bank Group, Inc. operates as a bank holding company. Its principal services are Banking Services, Trust and Asset Management Services, and Brokerage Services. The firm provides traditional deposit and credit services, mortgage banking, asset management, trust, merchant services, bank cards, data processing and securities brokerage services. The company was founded on December 13, 1982 and is headquartered in Tallahassee, FL.
info.description_zh: Capital City Bank Group, Inc. 以銀行控股公司經營。其主要服務包括銀行服務、信託和資產管理服務以及經紀服務。該公司提供傳統的存款和信貸服務、抵押銀行業務、資產管理、信託、商業服務、銀行卡、資料處理和證券經紀服務。該公司成立於1982年12月13日，總部位於佛羅裡達州塔拉哈西。

info.description: Scholar Rock Holding Corp. is a biopharmaceutical company. It engages in the business of discovering, developing, and delivering innovative medicines for the treatment of serious diseases in which signaling by protein growth factors plays a fundamental role. The company was founded by Timothy A. Springer and Leonard I. Zon in October 2012 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: 學者石控股公司是一家生物製藥公司。該公司從事發現、開發和提供用於治療嚴重疾病的創新藥物的業務，其中蛋白質生長因子的信號傳導發揮重要作用。該公司由 Timothy A. Springer 和 Leonard I. Zon 於 2012 年 10 月創立，總部位於麻薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: Hillman Solutions Corp. engages in the distribution of hardware and home improvement products. It operates through the following segments: Hardware and Protective Solutions, Robotics and Digital Solutions, and Canada. The Hardware and Protective Solutions segment includes fasteners, builders, wall hanging, threaded rod and metal shapes, letters, numbers, and signs, and personal protective equipment products. The Robotics and Digital Solutions segment consists of software-enabled key duplication and engraving solutions. The Canada segment focuses on distribution of fasteners and related hardware items, threaded rod, keys, key duplicating systems, accessories, identification items, tags and letters, numbers, and signs. The company was founded by Max W. Hillman Sr. in 1964 and is headquartered in Cincinnati, OH.
info.description_zh: Hillman Solutions Corp. 從事五金和家居裝修產品的分銷。該公司透過以下部門運作：硬體和防護解決方案部門、機器人和數位解決方案部門以及加拿大部門。五金和防護解決方案部門包括緊固件、建築工具、壁掛、螺紋桿和金屬型材、字母、數字和標誌以及個人防護設備產品。機器人和數位解決方案部門由軟體驅動的鑰匙複製和雕刻解決方案組成。加拿大分部專注於分銷緊固件及相關五金製品、螺紋桿、鑰匙、鑰匙複製系統、配件、識別物品、標籤和字母、數字和標誌。該公司由 Max W. Hillman Sr. 於 1964 年創立，總部位於俄亥俄州辛辛那提。

info.description: Kingstone Cos., Inc. operates as a holding company, which engages in the provision of property and casualty insurance policies to individuals and small businesses through its subsidiary. Its writing business are carried through independent retail and wholesale agents and brokers. The company was founded in 1886 and is headquartered in Kingston, NY.
info.industry_zh: 保險 - 財產與意外傷害
info.description_zh: Kingstone Cos., Inc. 作為控股公司運營，透過其子公司向個人和小型企業提供財產和傷亡保險。其寫作業務透過獨立的零售和批發代理商和經紀人進行。該公司成立於 1886 年，總部位於紐約州金斯頓。

info.description: Ameren Corp. is a public utility holding company, which engages in the provision of electric and natural gas services. It operates through the following segments: Ameren Missouri, Ameren Illinois Electric Distribution, Ameren Illinois Natural Gas, Ameren Transmission, and Other. The Ameren Transmission segment consists of the aggregated electric transmission businesses of Ameren Illinois and Ameren Transmission Company of Illinois (ATXI). The company was founded in 1902 and is headquartered in St. Louis, MO.
info.industry_zh: 公用事業 - 受監管的電力
info.description_zh: Ameren Corp. 是一家公用事業控股公司，從事提供電力和天然氣服務。該公司透過以下部門營運：Ameren 密蘇裡州、Ameren 伊利諾伊州電力分配部門、Ameren 伊利諾伊州天然氣部門、Ameren 傳輸部門和其他部門。 Ameren Transmission 部門由伊利諾州 Ameren Transmission Company 和伊利諾州 Ameren Transmission Company (ATXI) 的綜合電力傳輸業務組成。該公司成立於 1902 年，總部位於密蘇裡州聖路易斯。

info.description: Basel Medical Group Ltd. is an investment holding company, which engages in providing orthopedic surgeries, medical care, and diagnosis services. Its services include orthopedic surgeries, medical care, rehabilitative therapy, physiotherapy, non-surgical treatments, medical diagnosis, magnetic resonance imaging, general surgery, x-ray, lump removal, sports medicine, and total hip replacement. The company was founded by Man Hing Yip on August 10, 2023 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: 巴塞尔医疗集团有限公司是一家投资控股公司，提供骨科手术、医疗保健和诊断服务。其服务包括骨科手术、医疗护理、康复治疗、物理治疗、非手术治疗、医学诊断、磁共振成像、普通外科、X光、肿块切除、运动医学和全髋关节置换术。該公司由Man Hing Yip於2023年8月10日創立，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Tarsus Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a commercial stage biopharmaceutical company focused on the development and commercialization of therapeutics, starting with eye care. Its product candidate, TP-03, is a novel therapeutic in Phase 2b/3 that is being developed for the treatment of blepharitis caused by the infestation of Demodex mites, which is referred to as Demodex blepharitis. It is also developing TP-04 for the potential treatment of Ocular Rosacea and TP-05 as an oral tablet for the potential prevention of Lyme disease. The company was founded by Bobak Azamian and D. Michael Ackermann in 2017 and is headquartered in Irvine, CA.
info.description_zh: Tarsus Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 是一家商業階段的生物製藥公司，專注於治療藥物的開發和商業化，從眼科護理開始。其候選產品TP-03是一種處於2b/3期的新型治療藥物，正在開發用於治療由蠕形蟎蟲感染引起的瞼緣炎（簡稱蠕形蟎瞼緣炎）。該公司還在開發 TP-04 用於潛在治療眼部紅斑痤瘡，以及 TP-05 作為口服片劑用於潛在預防萊姆病。該公司由 Bobak Azamian 和 D. Michael Ackermann 於 2017 年創立，總部位於加州歐文。

info.description: UTime Ltd. engages in the operation of designing, manufacturing, and marketing mobile communication devices, and selling a variety of related accessories. The firm is also involved in providing mobile devices to consumers and help individuals from established markets in having better access to updated mobile technology. The company was founded by Min Fei Bao, Jun Lin Zhou, and Bo Tang in June 2008 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
info.description_zh: UTime Ltd.從事設計、製造和行銷行動通訊設備以及銷售各種相關配件的業務。該公司還致力於向消費者提供行動設備，並幫助成熟市場的個人更好地獲得最新的行動技術。該公司由鮑敏飛、周俊林和唐博於2008年6月創立，總部位於中國深圳。

info.description: Eversource Energy engages in the generation, transmission, and distribution of natural gas and electricity. It operates through the following segments: Electric Distribution, Electric Transmission, Natural Gas Distribution, Water Distribution, and Other. The Electric Distribution segment distributes electricity to retail customers. The Electric Transmission segment owns and maintains transmission facilities through CL&P, NSTAR Electric, PSNH, and WMECO. The Natural Gas Distribution segment transmits and distributes natural gas to retail customers. The Water Distribution segment operates five separate regulated water utilities in Connecticut, Massachusetts, and New Hampshire. The company was founded on July 1, 1966, and is headquartered in Springfield, MA.
info.industry_zh: 公用事業 - 受監管的電力
info.description_zh: Eversource Energy 從事天然氣和電力的生產、傳輸和分配。它透過以下部門運作：配電、電力傳輸、天然氣配送、供水和其他部門。電力分配部門向零售客戶分配電力。電力傳輸部門透過 CL&P、NSTAR Electric、PSNH 和 WMECO 擁有並維護傳輸設施。天然氣分銷部門向零售客戶傳輸和分銷天然氣。配水部門在康乃狄克州、麻薩諸塞州和新罕布夏州經營五個獨立的受監管的供水公司。該公司成立於 1966 年 7 月 1 日，總部位於馬薩諸塞州斯普林菲爾德。

info.description: The Southern Co is a holding company, which engages in the generation and sale of electricity. It operates through the following segments: Traditional Electric Operating Companies, Southern Power, and Southern Company Gas. The Traditional Electric Operating Companies segment refers to vertically integrated utilities that own generation, transmission and distribution facilities, and supplies electric services in the states of Alabama, Georgia, Florida, and Mississippi. The Southern Power segment constructs, acquires, owns, and manages generation assets such as renewable energy projects and sells electricity in the wholesale market. The Southern Company Gas segment distributes natural gas through natural gas distribution facilities in the states of Illinois, Georgia, Virginia, New Jersey, Florida, Tennessee, and Maryland. The company was founded on November 9, 1945, and is headquartered in Atlanta, GA.
info.industry_zh: 公用事業 - 受監管的電力
info.description_zh: 南方公司是一家控股公司，從事發電和銷售電力。該公司透過以下部門營運：傳統電力營運公司、南方電力部門和南方天然氣公司部門。傳統電力營運公司部門是指擁有發電、輸電和配電設施並在阿拉巴馬州、喬治亞州、佛羅裡達州和密西西比州提供電力服務的垂直整合公用事業公司。南方電力部門建設、收購、擁有和管理再生能源項目等發電資產，並在批發市場銷售電力。南方公司天然氣部門透過伊利諾州、喬治亞州、維吉尼亞州、新澤西州、佛羅裡達州、田納西州和馬裡蘭州的天然氣分配設施分配天然氣。該公司成立於 1945 年 11 月 9 日，總部位於喬治亞州亞特蘭大。

info.description: Donegal Group, Inc. is an insurance holding company, which engages in the provision of property and casualty insurance to businesses and individuals. It operates through the following segments: Investment Function, Personal Lines of Insurance, and Commercial Lines of Insurance. The Investment Function segment covers investment activities. The Personal Lines of Insurance segment consists of homeowners and private passenger automobile policies. The Commercial Lines of Insurance segment includes commercial automobile, commercial multi-peril, and workers compensation policies. The company was founded on August 26, 1986 and is headquartered in Marietta, PA.
info.industry_zh: 保險 - 財產與意外傷害
info.description_zh: Donegal Group, Inc.是一家保險控股公司，致力於向企業和個人提供財產和傷亡保險。它透過以下部門運作：投資職能部門、個人保險業務部門和商業保險業務部門。投資功能部分涵蓋投資活動。個人保險部分包括房屋所有權人和私人乘用車保單。商業保險業務部門包括商業汽車、商業多重險和工人賠償保單。該公司成立於1986年8月26日，總部位於賓州瑪麗埃塔。

info.description: Aterian, Inc. is a technology enabled consumer products company. The company's brands include hOme, Vremi, Xtava and RIF6. Its product categories include home and kitchen appliances, kitchenware, environmental appliances, beauty related products and consumer electronics. The company was founded by Yaniv Sarig Zion in 2014 and is headquartered in Summit, NJ.
info.description_zh: Aterian, Inc. 是一家技術支援的消費品公司。該公司的品牌包括 hOme、Vremi、Xtava 和 RIF6。其產品類別包括家居及廚房電器、廚具、環保電器、美容相關產品及消費性電子產品。該公司由 Yaniv Sarig Zion 於 2014 年創立，總部位於新澤西州薩米特。

info.description: Everest Group Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of reinsurance and insurance services. It operates through the following segments: Reinsurance, and Insurance. The Reinsurance segment writes property and casualty reinsurance and specialty lines of business, including marine, aviation, surety, and accident and health business, on both a treaty and facultative basis, through reinsurance brokers, as well as directly with ceding companies primarily within the U.S. The Insurance segment writes property and casualty insurance directly and through brokers, surplus lines brokers, and general agents within the U.S., Canada, and Europe. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Hamilton, Bermuda.
info.description_zh: Everest Group Ltd.是一家控股公司，從事提供再保險和保險服務。它透過以下部門運作：再保險和保險。再保險部門透過再保險經紀人以及直接與主要位於美國境內的分保公司，在條約和臨時基礎上承保財產和傷亡再保險以及專業業務，包括海上、航空、擔保以及事故和健康業務。保險部門直接並透過美國、加拿大和歐洲境內的經紀人、盈餘保險經紀人和總代理承保財產和傷亡保險。該公司成立於1999年，總部位於百慕達漢密爾頓。

info.description: Design Therapeutics, Inc. operates as a biotechnology company that develops therapies for serious degenerative disorders. It is created to design, develop and commercialize a novel class of small molecule therapeutic candidates (GeneTACs) designed to directly address the underlying basis of genetic disease. The company was founded by Pratik Shah and Aseem Z. Ansari on December 18, 2017 and is headquartered in Carlsbad, CA.
info.description_zh: Design Therapeutics, Inc. 是一家生技公司，開發嚴重退化性疾病的療法。它的創建是為了設計、開發和商業化一類新型小分子候選治療藥物 (GeneTAC)，旨在直接解決遺傳疾病的根本問題。該公司由 Pratik Shah 和 Asem Z. Ansari 於 2017 年 12 月 18 日創立，總部位於加州卡爾斯巴德。

info.description: Greenlight Capital Re Ltd. operates as a specialist property and casualty reinsurance company. It specializes in underwriting traditional property and casualty reinsurance, risk innovation, and strategic partnerships. The company was founded on July 13, 2004 and is headquartered in Camana Bay, Cayman Islands.
info.description_zh: Greenlight Capital Re Ltd. 是一家專業財產和傷亡再保險公司。它專門承保傳統財產和傷亡再保險、風險創新和戰略合作夥伴關係。該公司成立於2004年7月13日，總部位於開曼群島卡馬納灣。

info.description: Richmond Mutual Bancorporation, Inc. operates as the holding company of First Bank Richmond. It aims to own all of the outstanding shares of capital stock of First Bank Richmond. The company was founded in 1887 and is headquartered in Richmond, IN.
info.description_zh: Richmond Mutual Bancorporation, Inc. 以里士滿第一銀行的控股公司運作。它的目標是擁有里士滿第一銀行的所有已發行股本。該公司成立於 1887 年，總部位於印第安納州里士滿。

info.description: The Eastern Co. engages in the design, manufacture, and sale of engineered solutions. The firm primarily provides engineered solutions support in the commercial transportation and logistics markets. The company was founded by Eben Tuttle in October 1858 and is headquartered in Shelton, CT.
info.description_zh: The Eastern Co. 從事工程解決方案的設計、製造和銷售。該公司主要為商業運輸和物流市場提供工程解決方案支援。該公司由 Eben Tuttle 於 1858 年 10 月創立，總部位於康乃狄克州謝爾頓。

info.description: 4DMT operates as a clinical-stage genetic medicines company focused on inventing and developing genetic medicines to treat large market diseases in ophthalmology, pulmonology and cardiology. It develops genetic medicines using its proprietary invention platform, Therapeutic Vector Evolution. It combines the power of the Nobel Prize-winning technology, directed evolution, with approximately one billion synthetic AAV capsid-derived sequences. Its product design, development and manufacturing engine create a valuable and diverse product pipeline. The company is currently advancing five clinical-stage and two preclinical product candidates, each tailored to address rare and large market diseases. 4DMT was founded by David H. Kirn, Melissa Kotterman, Theresa Janke, and David Schaffer on September 12, 2013 and is headquartered in Emeryville, CA.
info.description_zh: 4DMT 是一家臨床階段的基因藥物公司，專注於發明和開發基因藥物，以治療眼科、肺部和心臟病學等大型市場疾病。它利用其專有的發明平台「治療載體進化」開發基因藥物。它將獲得諾貝爾獎的技術、定向進化的力量與大約十億個合成的 AAV 衣殼衍生序列結合在一起。其產品設計、開發和製造引擎創造了有價值且多樣化的產品線。該公司目前正在推進五種臨床階段和兩種臨床前候選產品，每種產品都是針對罕見和大型市場疾病量身定制的。 4DMT 由 David H. Kirn、Melissa Kotterman、Theresa Janke 和 David Schaffer 於 2013 年 9 月 12 日創立，總部位於加州埃默里維爾。

info.description: The Williams Cos., Inc. operates as an energy infrastructure company, which explores, produces, transports, sells and processes natural gas and petroleum products. It operates through the following segments: Transmission and Gulf of Mexico, Northeast G&P, and West. The Transmission and Gulf of Mexico segment consists of interstate natural gas pipelines, the Transco and Northwest Pipelines, as well as natural gas gathering and processing and crude oil production handling and transportation assets in the Gulf Coast region. The Northeast G&P segment includes midstream gathering, processing, and fractionation businesses in the Marcellus Shale region primarily in Pennsylvania and New York, and the Utica Shale region of eastern Ohio. The West segment consists of gas gathering, processing, and treating operations in the Rocky Mountain region of Colorado and Wyoming, the Barnett Shale region of north-central Texas, the Eagle Ford Shale region of south Texas, the Haynesville Shale region of northwest Louisiana, and the Mid-Continent region which includes the Anadarko, Arkoma, and Permian basins. The company was founded by David Williams and Miller Williams in 1908 and is headquartered in Tulsa, OK.
info.description_zh: Williams Cos., Inc. 是一家能源基礎設施公司，從事天然氣和石油產品的勘探、生產、運輸、銷售和加工。該公司透過以下部門運作：傳輸和墨西哥灣部門、東北 G&P 部門和西部部門。傳輸和墨西哥灣部分包括州際天然氣管道、Transco 和西北管道，以及墨西哥灣沿岸地區的天然氣收集和加工以及原油生產處理和運輸資產。 Northeast G&P 部門包括主要位於賓夕法尼亞州和紐約州的馬塞勒斯頁岩地區以及俄亥俄州東部的尤蒂卡頁岩地區的中游收集、加工和分餾業務。西段包括科羅拉多州和懷俄明州落基山地區、德克薩斯州中北部巴尼特頁岩地區、德克薩斯州南部伊格爾福特頁岩地區、路易斯安那州西北部海恩斯維爾頁岩地區以及包括阿納達科盆地、阿科馬盆地和二疊紀盆地在內的中大陸地區的天然氣收集、加工和處理業務。該公司由 David Williams 和 Miller Williams 於 1908 年創立，總部位於俄克拉荷馬州塔爾薩。

info.description: Brown-Forman Corp. engages in the production and distribution of alcoholic beverages. The firm offers whiskey, scotch, tequila, vodka, liquor, and wine. Its brands include Jack Daniel's, Woodford Reserve, Old Forester, Early Times, Canadian Mist, Coopers' Craft, Slane Irish, Finlandia, Korbel, El Jimador, Sonoma Cutrer, and Chambord. The company was founded by George Garvin Brown in 1870 and is headquartered in Louisville, KY.
info.industry_zh: 飲料 - 釀酒廠和釀酒廠
info.description_zh: Brown-Forman Corp. 從事酒精飲料的生產和分銷。該公司提供威士忌、蘇格蘭威士忌、龍舌蘭、伏特加、烈酒和葡萄酒。其品牌包括 Jack Daniel's、Woodford Reserve、Old Forester、Early Times、Canadian Mist、Coopers' Craft、Slane Irish、Finlandia、Korbel、El Jimador、Sonoma Cutrer 和 Chambord。該公司由 George Garvin Brown 於 1870 年創立，總部位於肯塔基州路易斯維爾。

info.description: CenterPoint Energy, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the business of power generation and distribution. It operates through the following segments: Electric, Corporate and Other, and Natural Gas. The Electric segment includes electric transmission and distribution services. The Corporate and Other segment refers to the energy performance contracting and sustainable infrastructure services. The Natural Gas segment is involved in the sales of intrastate natural gas, permanent pipeline connections, and home appliance maintenance and repair services. The company was founded in 1866 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.industry_zh: 公用事業 - 受監管的電力
info.description_zh: CenterPoint Energy, Inc.是一家控股公司，從事發電和配電業務。它透過以下部門運作：電力部門、企業及其他部門以及天然氣部門。電力部門包括輸電和配電服務。企業及其他部門是指能源績效承包和永續基礎設施服務。 The Natural Gas segment is involved in the sales of intrastate natural gas, permanent pipeline connections, and home appliance maintenance and repair services.該公司成立於 1866 年，總部位於德克薩斯州休斯頓。

info.description: Mettler-Toledo International, Inc. engages in the provision of precision instruments and services. The firm manufactures weighing instruments for use in laboratory, industrial, packaging, logistics, and food retailing applications. It also manufactures several related analytical instruments and provides automated chemistry solutions used in drug and chemical compound discovery and development, metal detection and other end-of-line inspection systems used in production and packaging and provides solutions for use in certain process analytics applications. It operates through the following segments: U.S. Operations, Swiss Operations, Western European Operations, Chinese Operations, and Other Operations. The U.S. Operations segment represents certain of the company's marketing and producing organizations located in the United States. The Swiss Operations segment is involved in the marketing and producing organizations located in Switzerland, as well as extensive research and development operations that are responsible for the development, production, and marketing of precision instruments, including weighing, analytical, and measurement technologies for use in a variety of industrial, and laboratory applications. The Western European Operations segment includes marketing and producing organizations in Western Europe, excluding operations located in Switzerland. The Chinese Operations segment focuses on marketing and producing organizations located in China. The Other Operations segment refers to the operations that exist outside these reportable segments. The company was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in Columbus, OH.
info.description_zh: 梅特勒-托利多國際公司從事提供精密儀器和服務。該公司生產用於實驗室、工業、包裝、物流和食品零售應用的稱重儀器。它還製造多種相關分析儀器，並提供用於藥物和化合物發現和開發、金屬檢測和生產和包裝中使用的其他下線檢測系統的自動化化學解決方案，並提供某些製程分析應用的解決方案。該公司透過以下部門營運：美國業務部門、瑞士業務部門、西歐業務部門、中國業務部門和其他業務部門。美國營運部門代表該公司位於美國的某些行銷和生產組織。瑞士營運部門參與位於瑞士的行銷和生產組織，以及負責精密儀器開發、生產和行銷的廣泛研發業務，包括用於各種工業和實驗室應用的稱重、分析和測量技術。西歐營運部門包括西歐的行銷和生產組織，不包括位於瑞士的營運。中國營運部門專注於位於中國的營銷和生產組織。其他業務分部是指存在於這些可報告分部以外的業務。該公司成立於 1991 年，總部位於俄亥俄州哥倫布。

info.description: Aeries Technology Inc. engages in the provision of professional and technology consulting services, to portfolio companies of private equity firms and middle market companies, specializing in the design, set-up, and management of Global Capability Centers for clients. It operates through the North America and Asia Pacific and Other geographical segments. The company was founded by Venu Raman Kumar and Sudhir Appukuttan Panikassery in 2012 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: Aeries Technology Inc. 致力於為私募股權公司和中間市場公司的投資組合公司提供專業和技術諮詢服務，專門為客戶設計、建立和管理全球能力中心。它透過北美、亞太地區和其他地區部門開展業務。該公司由 Venu Raman Kumar 和 Sudhir Appukuttan Panikassery 於 2012 年創立，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Global X Aging Population ETF seeks results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Indxx Aging Population Thematic Index. The fund invests more than 80% of its total assets in the securities of the underlying index. The underlying index is designed to provide exposure to exchange-listed companies in developed markets that facilitate the demographic trend of longer average life spans and the aging of the global population, including but not limited to companies involved in biotechnology, medical devices, pharmaceuticals, senior living facilities and specialized health care services.
info.description_zh: Global X 老齡化人口 ETF 尋求與 Indxx 老齡化人口主題指數的價格和收益率表現（未計費用和開支）大致相對應的結果。該基金將其總資產的80%以上投資於標的指數的證券。該指數旨在提供對已開發市場上市公司的投資，這些公司促進了平均壽命延長和全球人口老化的人口趨勢，包括但不限於涉及生物技術、醫療器材、製藥、老年生活設施和專業醫療保健服務的公司。

info.description: AquaBounty Technologies, Inc. engages in the provision of land-based aquaculture services. It includes farming of aquatic organisms such as fish, shellfish, crustaceans, and aquatic plants. The firm focuses on a salmon product, a bioengineered Atlantic salmon that can grow to market size faster than conventional farmed Atlantic salmon. The company was founded by Elliot Z. Entis and Garth L. Fletcher on December 17, 1991 and is headquartered in Harvard, MA.
info.description_zh: AquaBounty Technologies, Inc. 從事提供陸基水產養殖服務。它包括魚類、貝類、甲殼類和水生植物等水生生物的養殖。該公司專注於鮭魚產品，這是一種生物工程大西洋鮭魚，它可以比傳統養殖的大西洋鮭魚更快長到上市尺寸。該公司由 Elliot Z. Entis 和 Garth L. Fletcher 於 1991 年 12 月 17 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州哈佛大學。

info.description: Balchem Corp. markets specialty performance ingredients and products. It operates through the following segments: Human Nutrition and Health, Animal Nutrition and Health and Specialty Products. The Human Nutrition and Health segment supplies ingredients in the food and beverage industry, providing customized solutions in powder, solid and liquid flavor delivery systems, spray dried emulsified powder systems, and cereal systems. The Animal Nutrition and Health segment consists of nutritional products derived from microencapsulation and chelation technologies in addition to basic choline chloride. The Specialty Products segment offers Ethylene oxide for the health care industry. The company was founded in 1967 and is headquartered in Montvale, NJ.
