info.description: BioCryst Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a biotechnology company. It engages in the provision of structure-guided drug design with the goal of developing oral small-molecule and protein therapeutics to target difficult-to-treat rare diseases. The company was founded by William M. Spencer III, Charles E. Bugg, and John A. Montgomery in 1986 and is headquartered in Durham, NC.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: BioCryst Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 是一家生技公司。它致力於提供結構指導的藥物設計，目標是開發口服小分子和蛋白質療法來治療難以治療的罕見疾病。該公司由 William M. Spencer III、Charles E. Bugg 和 John A. Montgomery 於 1986 年創立，總部位於北卡羅來納州達勒姆。

info.description: Nicholas Bitcoin Tail ETF is an actively managed fund that implements a systematic options-based strategy designed to hedge against significant declines in the price of bitcoin and bitcoin-related investments. The fund seeks to provide investors with a "tail risk" or defensive profile relative to the cryptocurrency market by utilizing long put options to capture gains during sharp market downturns while employing call spreads to mitigate the cost of the protection.
info.description_zh: Nicholas Bitcoin Tail ETF 是一檔積極管理的基金，實施基於選擇權的系統策略，旨在對沖比特幣和比特幣相關投資價格的大幅下跌。該基金旨在透過利用多頭看跌期權在市場急劇下滑期間獲取收益，同時利用看漲期權價差來降低保護成本，為投資者提供相對於加密貨幣市場的「尾部風險」或防禦性配置。

info.description: Bluerock Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company, which engages in the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or other similar business combination, involving one or more businesses or assets. The company was founded on July 11, 2025 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Bluerock Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司，其目的是實現涉及一項或多項業務或資產的合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或其他類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年7月11日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Boundless Bio, Inc. is a clinical-stage oncology company, which is dedicated to unlocking a new paradigm in cancer therapeutics that addresses the significant unmet need in patients with oncogene amplified tumors by targeting extrachromosomal DNA. The company was founded by Vineet Bafna, Paul Mischel, Benjamin F. Cravatt, and Jonathan E. Lim on April 10, 2018 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Boundless Bio, Inc.是一家臨床階段的腫瘤公司，致力於開啟癌症治療的新範例，透過靶向染色體外DNA來解決致癌基因擴增腫瘤患者未滿足的重大需求。該公司由 Vineet Bafna、Paul Mischel、Benjamin F. Cravatt 和 Jonathan E. Lim 於 2018 年 4 月 10 日創立，總部位於加州聖地牙哥。

info.description: BUUU Group Ltd. is a holding company, which operates through its subsidiaries, BU Creation and BU Workshop. Its subsidiaries engage in design, planning and production of face-to-face events, immersive environments and brand-based experiences for clients and venues, including event organizers, consumer brand marketers and retail shopping centers. The company was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: BUUU Group Ltd. 是一家控股公司，透過其子公司 BU Creation 和 BU Workshop 營運。其子公司為客戶和場地（包括活動組織者、消費品牌行銷商和零售購物中心）設計、規劃和製作面對面活動、沉浸式環境和基於品牌的體驗。該公司成立於2017年，總部位於香港。

info.description: Cargurus, Inc. is an online automotive platform, which engages in buying and selling vehicles that is building upon its listings marketplace with digital retail solutions and the CarOffer digital wholesale platform. It operates through the following segments: U.S. Marketplace, Digital Wholesale, and Other. The U.S. Marketplace segment offers marketplace services from customers. The Digital Wholesale segment consists of dealer-to-dealer and IMCO services and products which are sold on the CarOffer platform. The company was founded by Langley Steinert on November 10, 2005 and is headquartered in Boston, MA.
info.description_zh: Cargurus, Inc. 是一個線上汽車平台，致力於購買和銷售車輛，該平台基於其列表市場，提供數位零售解決方案和 CarOffer 數位批發平台。它透過以下部門運作：美國市場、數位批發和其他部門。美國市場部門為客戶提供市場服務。 The Digital Wholesale segment consists of dealer-to-dealer and IMCO services and products which are sold on the CarOffer platform.該公司由 Langley Steinert 於 2005 年 11 月 10 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州波士頓。

info.description: Pathward Financial, Inc. is a financial holding company, which provides savings and loan services. The firm operates through the following business segments: Consumer, Commercial, and Corporate Services/Other. The Consumer segment collaborates with partners to navigate payment and lending needs. The Commercial segment refers to the commercial finance business line, which helps businesses access funds they need to launch, operate, and grow. The Corporate Services/Other segment consists of certain shared services, treasury, retained community bank portfolio, and student loan lending. The company was founded on June 14, 1993 and is headquartered in Sioux Falls, SD.
info.description_zh: Pathward Financial, Inc.是一家提供儲蓄和貸款服務的金融控股公司。該公司透過以下業務部門運作：消費者、商業和企業服務/其他。消費者部門與合作夥伴合作以滿足支付和貸款需求。商業部門是指商業金融業務線，幫助企業獲得啟動、營運和發展所需的資金。企業服務/其他部門包括某些共享服務、財務、保留的社區銀行投資組合和學生貸款。該公司成立於 1993 年 6 月 14 日，總部位於南達科他州蘇福爾斯。

info.description: Coincheck Group NV operates multi-cryptocurrency marketplaces and crypto asset exchanges in Japan. It provides exchange platforms on cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin and Ethereum. It owns the Next Finance Tech Company Limited that offers staking services to retail customers and corporate clients. The company was founded on February 18, 2022 and is headquartered in Amsterdam, Netherland.
info.description_zh: Coincheck Group NV 在日本經營多種加密貨幣市場和加密資產交易所。它提供包括比特幣和以太坊在內的加密貨幣的交易平台。它擁有Next Finance Tech Company Limited，為零售客戶和企業客戶提供質押服務。該公司成立於2022年2月18日，總部位於荷蘭阿姆斯特丹。

info.description: Encore Capital Group, Inc. is an international specialty finance company, which engages in the provision of debt recovery solutions. It operates through the following geographical segments: United States, Europe, and Other Geographies. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Encore Capital Group, Inc.是一家國際專業金融公司，提供債務追償解決方案。它透過以下地理區域運作：美國、歐洲和其他地區。該公司成立於 1999 年，總部位於加利福尼亞州聖地亞哥。

info.description: Flywire Corp. is a payments enablement and software company. The firm engages in providing vertical-specific software and payments technology to embed within the existing accounts receivable (AR) workflows for clients across the education, healthcare, travel vertical markets, and business-to-business (B2B) industries. It also integrates with enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, such as NetSuite, which allows organizations to optimize the payment experience of customers. The company was founded by Marcaide Marchite Iker in July 2009 and is headquartered in Boston, MA.
info.description_zh: Flywire Corp. 是一家支付支援和軟體公司。該公司致力於為教育、醫療保健、旅遊垂直市場和企業對企業 (B2B) 行業的客戶提供垂直特定的軟體和支付技術，嵌入現有的應收帳款 (AR) 工作流程中。它還與 NetSuite 等企業資源規劃 (ERP) 系統集成，使組織能夠優化客戶的支付體驗。該公司由 Marcaide Marchite Iker 於 2009 年 7 月創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州波士頓。

info.description: FirstSun Capital Bancorp engages in the provision of commercial banking services. It operates through the following segments: Banking, Mortgage Operations, and Corporate. The Banking segment consists of loans and provides deposits and fee-based services to consumer, business, and mortgage lending customers. The Mortgage Operations segment originates, sells, services, and manages market risk from changes in interest rates on one-to-four family residential mortgage loans to sell and hold. The company is founded on November 9, 1981 headquartered in Denver, CO.
info.description_zh: FirstSun Capital Bancorp 從事提供商業銀行服務。它透過以下部門運作：銀行部門、抵押貸款業務部門和企業部門。銀行業務部門包括貸款，並向消費者、企業和抵押貸款客戶提供存款和收費服務。抵押貸款業務部門發起、銷售、服務並管理出售和持有的一比四家庭住宅抵押貸款利率變化所帶來的市場風險。該公司成立於 1981 年 11 月 9 日，總部位於科羅拉多州丹佛市。

info.description: Global Interactive Technologies, Inc. engages in the provision of a global multi-media platform for users to interact with other like-minded users to share appreciation of various types of entertainment and cultures such as K-POP and modern Korean culture. It operates through the FANTOO platform. The company was founded on October 20, 2021 and is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.
info.description_zh: Global Interactive Technologies, Inc. 致力於提供一個全球多媒體平台，讓用戶與其他志同道合的用戶互動，分享對各種類型的娛樂和文化的欣賞，例如 K-POP 和現代韓國文化。它透過 FANTOO 平台運作。該公司成立於2021年10月20日，總部位於韓國首爾。

info.description: GSR IV Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It engages in the effecting of a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded in May 10, 2023 and is headquartered in Austin, TX.
info.description_zh: GSR IV Acquisition Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司運作。它從事與一個或多個企業的合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2023年5月10日，總部位於德州奧斯汀。

info.description: Harvard Ave Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company, which engages in the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on August 15, 2024 and is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.
info.description_zh: 哈佛大道收購公司是一家空白支票公司，其目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、資本股票交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2024年8月15日，總部位於韓國首爾。

info.description: Immix Biopharma, Inc. operates as a biopharmaceutical company that engages in the development of therapies for cancer and inflammatory diseases. The company was founded by Ilya Rachman, Sean Senn, and Vladimir Torchilin in 2012 and is headquartered in Los Angeles, CA.
info.description_zh: Immix Biopharma, Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司，致力於癌症和發炎性疾病療法的開發。該公司由 Ilya Rachman、Sean Senn 和 Vladimir Torchilin 於 2012 年創立，總部位於加州洛杉磯。

info.description: Jefferson Capital, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in purchasing and managing of charge-off and insolvency consumer accounts. It operates through the following geographical segments: the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and Latin America. It purchases and services both secured and unsecured assets, and its growing client base includes Fortune 500 creditors, banks, fintech origination platforms, telecommunications providers, credit card issuers and auto finance companies. The company was founded by David M. Burton in 2002 and is headquartered in Minneapolis, MN.
info.description_zh: Jefferson Capital, Inc. 是一家控股公司，從事沖銷和破產消費者帳戶的購買和管理業務。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美國、加拿大、英國和拉丁美洲。該公司購買有擔保和無擔保資產並提供服務，其不斷增長的客戶群包括財富 500 強債權人、銀行、金融科技發起平台、電信提供商、信用卡發行機構和汽車金融公司。該公司由 David M. Burton 於 2002 年創立，總部位於明尼蘇達州明尼阿波利斯。

info.description: Kura Oncology, Inc. operates as a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the research and development of medicines for the treatment of cancer. Its pipeline includes Tipifarnib, which is a Farnesyl transferase inhibitor for HRAS Mutant Solid Tumors, Chronic Myelomonocytic Leukemia, KO-947, which is an ERK inhibitor for MAPK Pathway Tumors, and KO-539, which is a Menin MLL inhibitor for acute leukemias. The company was founded by Troy E. Wilson, Yi Liu, Pingda Ren and Antonio Gualberto on August 22, 2014 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.

info.description: Live Oak Acquisition Corp. V is a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on November 27, 2024 and is headquartered in Memphis, TN.
info.description_zh: Live Oak Acquisition Corp. V 是一家空白支票公司。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2024年11月27日，總部位於田納西州孟菲斯。

info.description: MGE Energy, Inc. engages in the provision of natural gases and electric services. It operates through the following segments: Regulated Electric Utility Operations, Regulated Gas Utility Operations, Non-Regulated Energy Operations, Transmission Investments, and All Other. The Regulated Electric Utility Operations segment involves generating, purchasing, and distributing electricity. The Regulated Gas Utility Operations segment includes purchasing and distributing natural gas. The Non-Regulated Energy Operations segment offers owning and leasing electric generating capacity. The Transmission Investments segment represents investment in American Transmission Company LLC, a company engaged in the business of providing electric transmission services primarily in Wisconsin. The All Other segment invests in companies and property that relate to the regulated operations and financing the regulated operations. The company was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Madison, WI.
info.industry_zh: 公用事業 - 受監管的電力
info.description_zh: MGE Energy, Inc. 從事提供天然氣和電力服務。它透過以下部門運作：受監管的電力營運部門、受監管的天然氣公用事業營運部門、非監管能源營運部門、輸電投資部門和所有其他部門。受監管的電力營運部門涉及發電、採購和配電。受監管的燃氣公用事業營運部門包括購買和分配天然氣。非監管能源營運部門提供擁有和租賃發電能力。 Transmission Investments 部門代表對 American Transmission Company LLC 的投資，該公司主要在威斯康辛州從事提供電力傳輸服務的業務。所有其他部門投資於與受監管業務相關的公司和財產，並為受監管業務提供融資。該公司成立於 2001 年，總部位於威斯康辛州麥迪遜。

info.description: Megan Holdings Ltd. engages in the development, construction, and maintenance of aquaculture farms and related works. It offers upgrading and maintenance of aquaculture and agriculture farms, design and development of new aquaculture and agriculture farms, and the sourcing of industrial supplies and rental of machinery for agriculture and aquaculture purposes. The company was founded in September 2020 and is headquartered in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
info.description_zh: Megan Holdings Ltd.從事水產養殖場及相關工程的開發、建設及維護。它提供水產養殖和農業農場的升級和維護、新水產養殖和農業農場的設計和開發，以及工業用品的採購和農業和水產養殖機械的租賃。該公司成立於2020年9月，總部位於馬來西亞吉隆坡。

info.description: ENDRA Life Sciences, Inc. engages in the development of medical devices for accurate liver fat measurement for use in metabolic disease detection and GLP-1 drug eligibility and management. The company was founded on July 18, 2007 and is headquartered in Ann Arbor, MI.
info.description_zh: ENDRA Life Sciences, Inc. 致力於開發用於準確測量肝臟脂肪的醫療設備，用於代謝疾病檢測以及 GLP-1 藥物資格和管理。該公司成立於2007年7月18日，總部位於密西根州安娜堡。

info.description: NewtekOne, Inc. is a financial holding company, which engages in the provision of business and financial solutions. Its brands include Newtek Bank, Newtek Lending, Newtek Payments, Newtek Insurance, Newtek Payroll, and Newtek Technology. The company was founded by Barry Sloane in 1998 and is headquartered in Boca Raton, FL.
info.description_zh: NewtekOne, Inc.是一家金融控股公司，從事提供業務和金融解決方案。其品牌包括 Newtek Bank、Newtek Lending、Newtek Payments、Newtek Insurance、Newtek Payroll 和 Newtek Technology。該公司由 Barry Sloane 於 1998 年創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州博卡拉頓。

info.description: OP Bancorp operates as a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of general commercial banking services through its subsidiary. It offers deposit, lending, online banking, cash management, e-statements, mobile banking, zelle, and wire transfer services. The firm serves the small- and medium-sized businesses, professionals, and residents primarily Korean and other ethnic minority communities. The company was founded on June 10, 2005 and is headquartered in Los Angeles, CA.

info.description: Oric Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development of cancer treatments that address mechanisms of therapeutic resistance. It specializes in hormone-dependent cancers, key tumor dependencies, and precision oncology. The company was founded by Charles L. Sawyers, Richard A. Heyman, and Scott Lowe in 2014 and is headquartered in South San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Oric Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 是一家臨床階段生物製藥公司，致力於開發解決治療抗藥性機制的癌症治療方法。它專門研究荷爾蒙依賴性癌症、關鍵腫瘤依賴性和精準腫瘤學。該公司由 Charles L. Sawyers、Richard A. Heyman 和 Scott Lowe 於 2014 年創立，總部位於加州南舊金山。

info.description: Vaxcyte, Inc. engages in the development of vaccines for infectious diseases. It focuses on conjugate vaccines and protein-based vaccines developed through the Sutro Biopharma's Xpress CF Platform, a cell-free protein synthesis technology. The company was founded by Grant E. Pickering and Jeff Fairman on November 27, 2013, and is headquartered in San Carlos, CA.
info.description_zh: Vaxcyte, Inc. 从事传染病疫苗的开发。它專注於透過 Sutro Biopharma 的 Xpress CF 平台（一種無細胞蛋白質合成技術）開發的結合疫苗和蛋白質疫苗。該公司由 Grant E. Pickering 和 Jeff Fairman 於 2013 年 11 月 27 日創立，總部位於加州聖卡洛斯。

info.description: Pure Cycle Corp. engages in the development of diversified land and water resources. It operates through the following segments: Water and Wastewater Resource Development, Land Development, and Single-family Rental. The Water and Wastewater Resource Development segment refers to using water rights owned or controlled by the firm. The Land Development segment includes all the activities necessary to develop and sell finished lots. The Single-Family Rental segment involves homes built on finished lots during land development activities. The company was founded in 1976 and is headquartered in Watkins, CO.
info.description_zh: Pure Cycle Corp.從事多元化土地和水資源開發。它透過以下部門運作：水和廢水資源開發、土地開發和單戶租賃。水和廢水資源開發部門是指使用公司擁有或控制的水權。土地開發部門包括開發和銷售成品地塊所需的所有活動。單戶住宅租賃部分涉及土地開發活動期間在成品地塊上建造的房屋。該公司成立於 1976 年，總部位於科羅拉多州沃特金斯。

info.description: Pulsenmore Ltd. engages in research and development, production, marketing, and sale of self-scan ultrasound devices for remote clinical diagnosis and screening. It also offers a mobile app that guides the patient through a self-scan and enables online consolation with a clinician; as well as a clinician dashboard that allows clinicians to review scans and interacts with the patient remotely. The company was founded by Elazar Sonnenschein on October 27, 2014 and is headquartered in Omer, Israel.
info.description_zh: Pulsenmore Ltd.從事用於遠端臨床診斷和篩檢的自掃描超音波設備的研發、生產、行銷和銷售。它還提供了一個行動應用程序，可以指導患者進行自我掃描，並可以與臨床醫生進行線上諮詢；以及臨床醫生儀表板，允許臨床醫生查看掃描結果並與患者遠端互動。該公司由Elazar Sonnenschein於2014年10月27日創立，總部位於以色列奧馬爾。

info.description: QuinStreet, Inc. engages in performance marketplaces and technologies for the financial and home services industries. Its approach to proprietary performance marketing technologies allows clients to engage high-intent digital media or traffic from a wide range of device types, in multiple formats or types of media, and in a wide range of cost-per-action. The company was founded by Douglas Valenti on April 16, 1999 and is headquartered in Foster City, CA.
info.description_zh: QuinStreet, Inc. 致力於金融和家庭服務業的績效市場和技術。其專有的績效行銷技術方法使客戶能夠以多種格式或類型的媒體以及各種每次操作成本來吸引來自各種設備類型的高意圖數位媒體或流量。該公司由 Douglas Valenti 於 1999 年 4 月 16 日創立，總部位於加州福斯特市。

info.description: Scage Future is a new energy smart solutions provider for heavy commercial vehicles. It develops and commercializes heavy-duty new energy trucks and components, and also provides related vehicle modification and leasing services. The company was founded by Chao Gao, Yuan Chi Guo, and Zi Qian Guan in June 2019 and is headquartered in Nanjing, China.
info.description_zh: Scage Future是重型商用車新能源智慧解決方案供應商。它開發和商業化重型新能源卡車及零件，並提供相關的車輛改裝和租賃服務。該公司由高超、郭元馳和關子謙於2019年6月創立，總部位於中國南京。

info.description: First Trust SMID Cap Rising Dividend Achievers ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an index called the Nasdaq US Small Mid Cap Rising Dividend AchieversTM Index (the "index"). The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in common stocks that comprise the index. The index is designed to provide access to a diversified portfolio of 100 small and mid cap companies with a history of raising their dividends and exhibit the characteristics to continue to do so in the future.
info.description_zh: First Trust SMID Cap Rising Dividend Achievers ETF 尋求與名為納斯達克美國中小型股 Rising Dividend AchieversTM 指數（「指數」）的指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的普通股。該指數旨在提供由 100 家中小型公司組成的多元化投資組合，這些公司具有提高股息的歷史，並表現出未來繼續這樣做的特徵。

info.description: Sight Sciences, Inc. is an ophthalmic medical device company, which focuses on the development and commercialization of surgical and nonsurgical technologies for the treatment of prevalent eye diseases. It operates through the Surgical Glaucoma and Dry Eye segments. The Surgical Glaucoma segment includes OMNI Surgical System for use in minimally invasive glaucoma procedures. The Dry Eye segment offers TearCare System and related components. The company was founded by Paul Badawi and David Y. Badawi in 2011 and is headquartered in Menlo Park, CA.
info.description_zh: Sight Sciences, Inc.是一家眼科醫療器材公司，專注於用於治療常見眼部疾病的手術和非手術技術的開發和商業化。它透過手術青光眼和乾眼症部門進行運作。青光眼手術部分包括用於微創青光眼手術的 OMNI 手術系統。乾眼部門提供淚液護理系統和相關組件。該公司由 Paul Badawi 和 David Y. Badawi 於 2011 年創立，總部位於加州門洛帕克。

info.description: Sky Quarry, Inc. is an energy solutions company, which engages in deploying technologies to facilitate the recycling of waste asphalt shingles and remediation of oil-saturated sands and soils, providing sustainable refined crude products. It develops its ECOSolv technology that processes the separation of oil from oily sands and other oil-bearing solids. The company was founded by David Owen Sealock and Marcus G. Laun on June 4, 2019 and is headquartered in Woods Cross, UT.
info.description_zh: Sky Quarry, Inc. 是一家能源解決方案公司，致力於部署技術以促進廢棄瀝青瓦的回收以及飽和油沙和土壤的修復，提供可持續的精煉原油產品。該公司開發了 ECOSolv 技術，可將石油從含油砂和其他含油固體中分離出來。該公司由 David Owen Sealock 和 Marcus G. Laun 於 2019 年 6 月 4 日創立，總部位於猶他州伍茲克羅斯。

info.description: Slide Insurance Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of property insurance. Its products include homeowners' insurance, condominium insurance, landlord insurance, and commercial residential insurance. The company was founded by Bruce Thomas Lucas and Shannon Lucas on March 2, 2021 and is headquartered in Tampa, FL.
info.industry_zh: 保險 - 財產與意外傷害
info.description_zh: Slide Insurance Holdings, Inc. 從事提供財產保險業務。其產品包括房屋保險、公寓保險、房東保險和商業住宅保險。該公司由 Bruce Thomas Lucas 和 Shannon Lucas 於 2021 年 3 月 2 日創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州坦帕。

info.description: SLM Corp. engages in the provision and administration of education loans. Its services include private education loans, banking, college savings, and insurance services. The company was founded in 1972 and is headquartered in Newark, DE.
info.description_zh: SLM Corp. 從事教育貸款的提供和管理。其服務包括私人教育貸款、銀行、大學儲蓄和保險服務。該公司成立於 1972 年，總部位於特拉華州紐瓦克。

info.description: Silence Therapeutics Plc engages in the discovery, delivery, and development of ribonucleic acid (RNA) therapeutics. It also develops medicines by harnessing the body's natural mechanism of RNA interference within its cells. The company was founded on November 18, 1994 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.
info.description_zh: Silence Therapeutics Plc 致力於核糖核酸 (RNA) 療法的發現、傳遞和開發。它還透過利用人類細胞內 RNA 幹擾的自然機制來開發藥物。該公司成立於1994年11月18日，總部位於英國倫敦。

info.description: Star Fashion Culture Holdings Ltd. engages in the provision of content marketing solutions. It offers marketing campaign planning and execution, offline advertising services, and online precision marketing services. The company was founded on August 11, 2023 and is headquartered in Xiamen, China.
info.description_zh: 星時尚文化控股有限公司從事提供內容行銷解決方案。提供行銷活動企劃與執行、線下廣告服務、線上精準行銷服務。公司成立於2023年8月11日，總部位於中國廈門。

info.description: The Wendy's Co. engages in operating, developing, and franchising a system of quick-service restaurants. It operates through the following segments: Wendy's U.S., Wendy's International, and Global Real Estate and Development. The Wendy's U.S. segment includes the operation and franchising of Wendy's restaurants in the U.S. The Wendy's International segment is involved in the operation and franchising of Wendy's restaurants in countries and territories other than the U.S. The Global Real Estate and Development segment focuses on real estate activity for owned sites and sites leased from third parties. The company was founded by R. David Thomas on November 15, 1969 and is headquartered in Dublin, OH.
info.description_zh: The Wendy's Co. 從事快餐店系統的營運、開發和特許經營。該公司透過以下部門營運：Wendy's U.S.、Wendy's International 和 Global Real Estate and Development。 Wendy's 美國分部包括 Wendy's 餐廳在美國的經營和特許經營。 Wendy's International 分部參與 Wendy's 餐廳在美國以外的國家和地區的經營和特許經營。全球房地產和開發分部專注於自有場地和從第三方租賃的場地的房地產活動。該公司由 R. David Thomas 於 1969 年 11 月 15 日創立，總部位於俄亥俄州都柏林。

info.description: Worksport Ltd. engages in the designing, development, manufacturing, and ownership of the intellectual property on a variety of tonneau covers, solar integrations, and non-parasitic, hydrogen-based green energy solutions. It assists businesses by acquiring investment capital for continued growth and expansion while providing business development and marketing strategies, and offers its services in the United States and Canada. The company was founded by Steven Rossi on April 2, 2003 and is headquartered in West Seneca, NY.
info.description_zh: Worksport Ltd. 從事各種酒桶蓋、太陽能整合和非寄生氫基綠色能源解決方案的設計、開發、製造和智慧財產權所有權。它透過獲取投資資本以實現持續成長和擴張，同時提供業務開發和行銷策略來協助企業，並在美國和加拿大提供服務。該公司由 Steven Rossi 於 2003 年 4 月 2 日創立，總部位於紐約州西塞尼卡。

info.description: Wintergreen Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on April 29, 2024 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: Wintergreen Acquisition Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司經營，其成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。公司成立於2024年4月29日，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: Global X U.S. Electrification ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Global X U.S. Electrification Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets, plus borrowings for investment purposes (if any), in the securities of the underlying index, which may include common stocks and American Depositary Receipts ("ADRs") based on the securities in the underlying index. The underlying index is, as presently constituted, designed to track the performance of U.S. listed companies domiciled in developed markets and involved in electrification. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X 美國電氣化 ETF 尋求提供與 Global X 美國電氣化指數未計費用和開支前的價格和收益率表現大致相符的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產以及用於投資目的的借款（如有）投資於基礎指數的證券，其中可能包括基於基礎指數中的證券的普通股和美國存託憑證（「ADR」）。按照目前的組成，該指數旨在追蹤位於已開發市場並涉及電氣化的美國上市公司的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Invest Green Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities. The company was founded by Matthew Kiernan and Andrew McLean on April 7, 2025 and is headquartered in Camas, WA.
info.description_zh: Invest Green Acquisition Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司營運。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業或實體合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司由 Matthew Kiernan 和 Andrew McLean 於 2025 年 4 月 7 日創立，總部位於華盛頓州卡馬斯。

info.description: SC II Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on June 30, 2025 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: SC II Acquisition Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司運作。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年6月30日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Ascendis Pharma A/S is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development of drug candidates. It specializes in its TransCon technologies to develop new therapies that address unmet medical needs. The company was founded by Jan Moller Mikkelsen, Dirk Vetter, and Harald Rau on September 21, 2006 and is headquartered in Hellerup, Denmark.
info.description_zh: Ascendis Pharma A/S 是一家生物製藥公司，從事候選藥物的開發。它專注於 TransCon 技術來開發新療法，以滿足未滿足的醫療需求。該公司由 Jan Moller Mikkelsen、Dirk Vetter 和 Harald Rau 於 2006 年 9 月 21 日創立，總部位於丹麥海勒魯普。

info.description: Invesco DWA SmallCap Momentum ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Dorsey Wright SmallCap Technical Leaders Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index is composed of approximately 200 securities from an eligible universe of approximately 2,000 securities ranked 1,001 to 3,000 by market capitalization within the NASDAQ US Benchmark Index.
info.description_zh: Invesco DWA SmallCap Momentum ETF 旨在追蹤 Dorsey Wright SmallCap Technical Leaders Index（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。標的指數由約 200 只證券組成，這些證券來自納斯達克美國基準指數市值排名 1,001 至 3,000 名的約 2,000 只合格證券。

info.description: Blue Bird Corp. engages in the design and manufacture of school buses. It operates through the Bus and Parts segments. The Bus segment includes the manufacturing and assembly of school buses to be sold to a variety of customers across the United States, Canada, and in international markets. The Parts segment focuses on the purchases of parts from third parties to be sold to dealers within the company's network and certain large fleet customers. The company was founded by Albert Laurence Luce in 1927 and is headquartered in Macon, GA.
info.description_zh: 藍鳥公司從事校車的設計和製造。它透過巴士和零件部門運作。巴士部門包括校車的製造和組裝，銷往美國、加拿大和國際市場的各種客戶。零件部門專注於從第三方購買零件，然後出售給公司網路內的經銷商和某些大型車隊客戶。該公司由 Albert Laurence Luce 於 1927 年創立，總部位於喬治亞州梅肯。

info.description: Vera Bradley, Inc. engages in the business of designing women's handbags, luggage, travel items, fashion, home accessories, and unique gifts. It operates through the following segments: Vera Bradley (VB) Direct and Vera Bradley Indirect. The VB Direct segment is involved in sale of VB products through full-line and factory outlet stores, websites, online outlet sites, and the VB annual outlet sale. The VB Indirect segment includes distribution of branded products to specialty retailers, select department stores, national accounts, third-party e-commerce sites, third-party inventory liquidators, and licensing agreements. The company was founded by Barbara Bradley Baekgaard and Patricia R. Miller in 1982 and is headquartered in Roanoke, IN.
info.description_zh: Vera Bradley, Inc. 從事女士手袋、行李箱、旅行用品、時尚、家居飾品和獨特禮品的設計業務。它透過以下部門運作：Vera Bradley (VB) Direct 部門和 Vera Bradley Indirect 部門。 VB Direct 部門透過全線直銷店、工廠直銷店、網站、線上直銷網站以及 VB 年度直銷銷售 VB 產品。 VB Indirect 部門包括向專業零售商、精選百貨公司、國民帳戶、第三方電子商務網站、第三方庫存清算商和授權協議分銷品牌產品。該公司由 Barbara Bradley Baekgaard 和 Patricia R. Miller 於 1982 年創立，總部位於印第安納州羅阿諾克。

info.description: Puma Biotechnology, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company. It acquires and develops innovative products for the treatment of various forms of cancer. It focuses on in-licensing drug candidates that are undergoing or have already completed initial clinical testing for the treatment of cancer and then seek to further develop those drug candidates for commercial use. The company was founded by Alan H. Auerbach on September 15, 2010 and is headquartered in Los Angeles, CA.
info.description_zh: Puma Biotechnology, Inc.是一家生物製藥公司。它收購並開發用於治療各種癌症的創新產品。它重點關注正在或已經完成癌症治療初步臨床測試的候選藥物，然後尋求進一步開發這些候選藥物用於商業用途。該公司由 Alan H. Auerbach 於 2010 年 9 月 15 日創立，總部位於加州洛杉磯。

info.description: Priority Technology Holdings, Inc. engages in collection, storage, lending, and sending money through its commerce engine. The firm provides merchant services, payables, banking, and treasury solutions. It operates through the following segments: Small and Medium-sized Businesses (SMB) Payments, Business-to-Business (B2B) Payments, and Enterprise Payments. The SMB Payments segment includes provision of full-service acquiring and payment-enabled solutions for business-to-consumer transactions. The B2B Payments segment relates to accounts for payable automation solutions to corporations, software partners, and financial institutions. The Enterprise Payments segment refers to provision of embedded finance and banking as a service (BaaS) solution to customers to modernize legacy platforms and accelerate software partners' strategies to monetize payments. The company was founded by John V. Priore, Thomas Charles Priore, and Sean Kiewiet in August 2005 and is headquartered in Alpharetta, GA.
info.description_zh: Priority Technology Holdings, Inc. 透過其商業引擎從事收款、儲存、借貸和匯款業務。該公司提供商業服務、應付帳款、銀行和財務解決方案。它透過以下部門運作：中小企業（SMB）支付、企業對企業（B2B）支付和企業支付。中小企業支付部門包括為企業對消費者交易提供全方位服務的收單和支付解決方案。 B2B 支付部門涉及企業、軟體合作夥伴和金融機構的應付帳款自動化解決方案。企業支付部門是指向客戶提供嵌入式金融和銀行即服務（BaaS）解決方案，以實現傳統平台的現代化並加速軟體合作夥伴的支付貨幣化策略。該公司由 John V. Priore、Thomas Charles Priore 和 Sean Kiewiet 於 2005 年 8 月創立，總部位於喬治亞州阿爾法利塔。

info.description: mF International Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the development and provision of financial trading solutions through its subsidiary. It offers real-time mission critical forex, bullion and commodities trading platform solutions, financial value-added services, mobile applications, and financial information for brokers and institutional clients via internet or platform as software as a service. The company was founded by Tai Wai Lam and Chi Weng Tam on June 15, 2022, and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: mF International Ltd. 是一家控股公司，透過其子公司從事開發和提供金融交易解決方案。它透過互聯網或平台即軟體即服務為經紀商和機構客戶提供即時任務關鍵型外匯、金銀和大宗商品交易平台解決方案、金融增值服務、行動應用程式和金融資訊。該公司由Tai Wai Lam和Chi Weng Tam於2022年6月15日創立，總部位於香港。

info.description: Equinix, Inc. is a digital infrastructure company, which engages in the provision of a platform that interconnects the foundational infrastructure. It operates through the following geographical segments: Americas, Europe, Middle East, and Africa, and Asia-Pacific. It offers digital services, data center services, interconnection services, and support services. The company was founded by Jay Steven Adelson and Albert M. Avery, IV on June 22, 1998 and is headquartered in Redwood City, CA.
info.industry_zh: 房地產投資信託基金 - 專業
info.description_zh: Equinix, Inc. 是一家數位基礎設施公司，致力於提供互連基礎設施的平台。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美洲、歐洲、中東、非洲和亞太地區。它提供數位服務、資料中心服務、互連服務和支援服務。該公司由 Jay Steven Adelson 和 Albert M. Avery, IV 於 1998 年 6 月 22 日創立，總部位於加州雷德伍德市。

info.description: F/m Emerald Special Situations ETF seeks long-term growth through capital appreciation. Under normal conditions, the fund typically invests in equity securities of U.S. and foreign companies, including common stocks, preferred stocks, and securities convertible into common or preferred stocks. It can invest in companies from a wide range of industries and of various sizes. The fund will invest primarily in mid and small-size companies.
info.description_zh: F/m Emerald Special Situations ETF 透過資本增值尋求長期成長。在正常情況下，該基金通常投資於美國和外國公司的股本證券，包括普通股、優先股以及可轉換為普通股或優先股的證券。它可以投資各個行業和各種規模的公司。該基金將主要投資於中小型企業。

info.description: Vir Biotechnology, Inc. operates as a clinical-stage immunology company that focuses on combining immunologic insights with cutting-edge technologies to treat and prevent serious infectious diseases. The firm's technology platforms include antibody, T cell, innate immunity and siRNA, which are designed to stimulate and enhance the immune system by exploiting critical observations of natural immune processes. The company was founded by Robert Taylor Nelsen, Klaus Frueh, Jay Parrish, Lawrence Corey, and Louis Picker in April 7, 2016 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Vir Biotechnology, Inc. 是一家臨床階段免疫學公司，專注於將免疫學見解與尖端技術相結合，以治療和預防嚴重傳染病。該公司的技術平台包括抗體、T 細胞、先天免疫和 siRNA，旨在透過利用對自然免疫過程的關鍵觀察來刺激和增強免疫系統。該公司由 Robert Taylor Nelsen、Klaus Frueh、Jay Parrish、Lawrence Corey 和 Louis Picker 於 2016 年 4 月 7 日創立，總部位於加州舊金山。

info.description: Playtika Holding Corp. engages in the development of mobile games. It builds live game operations services and a proprietary technology platform to support its portfolio of games. Its games include Slotomania, Bingo Blitz, House of Fun, Solitaire Grand Harvest, June's Journey, Caesars Slots, Best Friends, Board Kings, and Redecor. The company was founded by Robert Antokol and Uri Shahak in 2010 and is headquartered in Herzliya, Israel.
info.description_zh: Playtika Holding Corp.從事手機遊戲開發。它建立了即時遊戲營運服務和專有技術平台來支援其遊戲組合。其遊戲包括 Slotomania、Bingo Blitz、House of Fun、Solitaire Grand Harvest、June's Journey、Caesars Slots、Best Friends、Board Kings 和 Redecor。該公司由 Robert Antokol 和 Uri Shahak 於 2010 年創立，總部位於以色列荷茲利亞。

info.description: Taylor Devices, Inc. engages in the design, development, manufacture, and marketing of shock absorption, rate control, and energy storage devices. Its products include metal bellows dampers, fluid viscous dampers, landing and arresting gear, pumpkin mounts, isolation systems, custom applications, crane buffers, shock absorbers, liquid die springs, lock up devices, machined springs, and actuators. The company was founded by Paul H. Taylor on July 22, 1955 and is headquartered in North Tonawanda, NY.
info.description_zh: Taylor Devices, Inc. 從事減震、速率控制和儲能設備的設計、開發、製造和行銷。其產品包括金屬波紋管阻尼器、流體黏性阻尼器、著陸和煞車裝置、南瓜支架、隔離系統、客製化應用、起重機緩衝器、避震器、液體模具彈簧、鎖定裝置、機械加工彈簧和執行器。該公司由 Paul H. Taylor 於 1955 年 7 月 22 日創立，總部位於紐約州北托納旺達。

info.description: Bel Fuse, Inc. engages in the design, manufacture, and marketing of products that power, protect, and connect electronic circuits. It operates through the following segments: Power Solutions & Protection, Connectivity Solutions, and Magnetic Solutions. The Power Solutions & Protection segment includes internal and external AC/DC power supplies, DC/DC converters and DC/AC inverters utilized in defense, commercial aerospace, industrial, networking and consumer applications. The Connectivity Solutions segment focuses on high speed and harsh environment copper and optical fiber connectors and integrated assemblies, providing connectivity solutions within the commercial aerospace, military communications, defense, network infrastructure, structured building cabling, and several industrial applications. The Magnetic Solutions segment is involved in integrating RJ45 connectors with discrete magnetic components to provide better performance and a more robust device, substantially reducing board space and optimizing performance. The company was founded by Elliot Bernstein in 1949 and is headquartered in West Orange, NJ.
info.description_zh: Bel Fuse, Inc. 從事為電子電路供電、保護和連接的產品的設計、製造和行銷。它透過以下部門運作：電源解決方案和保護、連接解決方案和磁性解決方案。電源解決方案和保護部門包括用於國防、商業航空航太、工業、網路和消費應用的內部和外部交流/直流電源、直流/直流轉換器和直流/交流逆變器。連接解決方案部門專注於高速和惡劣環境銅和光纖連接器和整合組件，為商業航空航太、軍事通訊、國防、網路基礎設施、結構化建築佈線和多種工業應用提供連接解決方案。磁性解決方案部門致力於將 RJ45 連接器與分離磁性組件集成，以提供更好的性能和更穩健的設備，從而大幅減少電路板空間並優化性能。該公司由 Elliot Bernstein 於 1949 年創立，總部位於新澤西州西奧蘭治。

info.description: Energy Services of America Corp. is a contractor and service company. It operates through the following segments: Underground Infrastructure Construction, Industrial Construction, and Building Construction. The Underground Infrastructure Construction segment primarily includes water and wastewater pipelines, natural gas distribution pipelines, natural gas transmission pipelines, natural gas stations and ancillary facilities, corrosion protection services, and horizontal drilling services. The Industrial Constructions segment involves electrical, mechanical, HVAC/R, controls, and fire protection services in automotive, chemical, power, and manufacturing facilities. The Building Construction segment refers to schools, local and state buildings, and small bridge projects. The company was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Huntington, WV.
info.description_zh: 美國能源服務公司是一家承包商和服務公司。它透過以下部門運作：地下基礎設施建設、工業建築和建築施工。地下基礎設施建設部門主要包括供水和污水管道、天然氣分配管道、天然氣輸送管道、天然氣站及附屬設施、腐蝕防護服務以及水平鑽井服務。工業建築部門涉及汽車、化學、電力和製造設施中的電氣、機械、HVAC/R、控制和消防服務。建築施工部分指學校、地方和州建築以及小型橋樑工程。該公司成立於 2006 年，總部位於西維吉尼亞州亨廷頓。

info.description: Asia Pacific Wire & Cable Corp. Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the business of owning operating companies in the power cable, telecommunication cable, enameled wire, and electronic cable industry. It operates through the following segments: North Asia, Thailand, and Rest of the World. The company was founded on September 19, 1996 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.
info.description_zh: 亞太電線電纜有限公司是一家控股公司，從事電力電纜、通訊電纜、漆包線、電子電纜行業的自營經營公司業務。它透過以下部門運作：北亞、泰國和世界其他地區。公司成立於1996年9月19日，總部位於台灣台北。

info.description: Motley Fool Momentum Factor ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the total return performance of the Motley Fool Momentum Index. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's total assets will be invested in the component securities of the index. The Adviser expects that, over time, if it has sufficient assets, the correlation between the fund's performance and that of the index, before fees and expenses, will be 95% or better. The fund will generally use a "replication" strategy to achieve its investment objective, meaning it generally will invest in all of the component securities of the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Motley Fool Momentum Factor ETF 尋求與 Motley Fool Momentum Index 的總回報表現大致相符的投資結果。一般情況下，基金總資產至少80%會投資於指數成分證券。顧問預計，隨著時間的推移，如果擁有足夠的資產，在扣除費用和開支之前，基金績效與指數績效之間的相關性將達到 95% 或更高。該基金通常會使用「複製」策略來實現其投資目標，這意味著它通常會投資於該指數的所有組成證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: SAB Biotherapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage, biopharmaceutical company, which engages in advancing a new class of immunotherapies leveraging fully-human polyclonal antibodies. The firm produces human polyclonal immunotherapies and its versatile DiversitAb platform is applicable for unmet needs in human diseases. The company was founded by Eddie J. Sullivan and Christine E. Hamilton in July 2014 and is headquartered in Miami Beach, FL.
info.description_zh: SAB Biotherapeutics, Inc. 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於推進利用全人多株抗體的新型免疫療法。該公司生產人類多克隆免疫療法，其多功能 DiversitAb 平台適用於人類疾病中未滿足的需求。該公司由 Eddie J. Sullivan 和 Christine E. Hamilton 於 2014 年 7 月創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密海灘。

info.description: HeartSciences, Inc. is a medical technology company, which focuses on applying innovative AI-based technology to an electrocardiogram (ECG) to expand and improve an ECG's clinical usefulness. Its objective is to make an ECG a far more valuable cardiac screening tool, particularly in frontline or point-of-care clinical settings. The firm offers MyoVista, a resting 12-lead ECG that is also designed to provide diagnostic information related to cardiac dysfunction. The company was founded on August 16, 2007 and is headquartered in Southlake, TX.
info.description_zh: HeartSciences, Inc. 是一家醫療技術公司，專注於將基於人工智慧的創新技術應用於心電圖 (ECG)，以擴展和提高心電圖的臨床實用性。其目標是使心電圖成為更有價值的心臟篩檢工具，特別是在前線或護理點臨床環境中。該公司提供 MyoVista，一種靜息 12 導程心電圖，也旨在提供與心臟功能障礙相關的診斷資訊。該公司成立於2007年8月16日，總部位於德克薩斯州南湖。

info.description: Westport Fuel Systems, Inc. engages in the business of engineering, manufacturing, and supplying alternative fuel systems and components for transportation applications. It operates through the following segments: Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEM), Independent Aftermarket (IAM), and Corporate. The OEM segment includes designing, manufacturing, and selling alternative fuel systems, components, and electronics including the HPDI 2.0 fuel systems product and engineering services. The IAM segment focuses on alternative fuel systems and components that consumers can purchase and have installed onto vehicles to use liquid petroleum or compressed natural gas fuels in addition to gasoline. The Corporate segment is involved in public company activities, corporate oversight, financing, capital allocation, and general administrative duties such as securing intellectual property. The company was founded on March 20, 1995 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
info.description_zh: Westport Fuel Systems, Inc. 從事運輸應用的工程、製造和供應替代燃料系統和組件的業務。它透過以下部門運作：原始設備製造商（OEM）、獨立售後市場（IAM）和企業。 OEM 部門包括設計、製造和銷售替代燃料系統、組件和電子產品，包括 HPDI 2.0 燃料系統產品和工程服務。 IAM 部門專注於替代燃料系統和組件，消費者可以購買這些系統和組件並將其安裝到車輛上，以使用汽油以外的液態石油或壓縮天然氣燃料。公司部門涉及上市公司活動、公司監督、融資、資本配置以及保護智慧財產權等一般管理職責。該公司成立於1995年3月20日，總部位於加拿大溫哥華。

info.description: CrossingBridge Pre-Merger SPAC ETF seeks to provide total returns consistent with the preservation of capital. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that under normal market conditions will invest at least 80% of its net assets, plus borrowings for investment purposes, in shares of common stock and units of Special Purpose Acquisitions Companies ("SPACs") that have yet to consummate a shareholder-approved merger or business combination. The fund seeks to invest in publicly-traded SPACs that at the time of purchase are trading at or below the SPAC's pro rata trust account value. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: CrossingBridge Pre-Merger SPAC ETF 尋求提供與資本保值一致的總回報。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），在正常市場條件下，將至少 80% 的淨資產以及用於投資目的的借款投資於尚未完成股東批准的合併或業務合併的普通股和特殊目的收購公司（「SPAC」）的單位。該基金尋求投資於公開交易的 SPAC，這些 SPAC 在購買時的交易價格等於或低於 SPAC 按比例的信託帳戶價值。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Vaneck Robotics ETF seeks to track as closely as possible, before fees and expenses, the price and yield performance of the BlueStar Robotics Index (the "index"). The fund normally invests at least 80% of its total assets in Robotics Companies. The index is comprised of equity securities, which may include depositary receipts of global exchange-listed companies in the robotics industry. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Vaneck Robotics ETF 力求在費用和支出之前盡可能密切地追蹤 BlueStar Robotics Index（「指數」）的價格和收益率表現。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於機器人公司。該指數由股本證券組成，其中可能包括機器人產業全球交易所上市公司的存託憑證。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Kentucky First Federal Bancorp is a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of banking products and services through its subsidiaries. The company was founded on March 2, 2005, and is headquartered in Hazard, KY.
info.description_zh: 肯塔基州第一聯邦銀行是一家銀行控股公司，透過其子公司提供銀行產品和服務。該公司成立於2005年3月2日，總部位於肯塔基州哈札德。

info.description: abrdn Emerging Markets Dividend Active ETF seeks total return consisting of income and long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of the value of its net assets, plus any borrowings for investment purposes, in equity securities of emerging market companies that pay dividend income. The fund will invest primarily in common stocks but may also invest in other types of equity securities, including, but not limited to, preferred stock and depositary receipts.
info.description_zh: abrdn 新興市場股息主動 ETF 尋求由收入和長期資本增值組成的總回報。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產價值以及任何用於投資目的的借款投資於支付股息收入的新興市場公司的股本證券。該基金將主要投資於普通股，但也可能投資於其他類型的股本證券，包括但不限於優先股和存託憑證。

info.description: Live Oak Acquisition Corp. V is a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on November 27, 2024 and is headquartered in Memphis, TN.
info.description_zh: Live Oak Acquisition Corp. V 是一家空白支票公司。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2024年11月27日，總部位於田納西州孟菲斯。

info.description: Artiva Biotherapeutics, Inc. operates as a biotechnology company for the treatment of hematologic cancers. It offers NK cell therapies for cancer. The company was founded by Thomas J. Farrell in 2019 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Artiva Biotherapeutics, Inc. 是一家治療血液癌症的生技公司。它提供癌症 NK 細胞療法。該公司由 Thomas J. Farrell 於 2019 年創立，總部位於加州聖地牙哥。

info.description: Neurogene, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company, which engages in the development of product portfolio of genetic medicines for rare neurological diseases. The company was founded in May 2007 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Neurogene, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物技術公司，從事罕見神經疾病基因藥物產品組合的開發。該公司成立於2007年5月，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Energy Recovery, Inc. engages in the design and manufacture of industrial fluid flow solutions. It operates through the following segments: Water, Emerging Technologies, and Corporate. The Water segment deals with the development, sales, and support of the PX, Turbochargers and pumps used in seawater desalination and industrial wastewater activities. The Emerging Technologies segment is composed of the development of the PX G1300 used in industrial and commercial refrigeration applications. The company was founded in April 1992 and is headquartered in San Leandro, CA.
info.description_zh: Energy Recovery, Inc. 從事工業流體流動解決方案的設計和製造。它透過以下部門運作：水務部門、新興技術部門和企業部門。水務部門負責海水淡化和工業廢水活動中使用的 PX、渦輪增壓器和泵浦的開發、銷售和支援。新興技術部分由用於工業和商業冷凍應用的 PX G1300 的開發組成。該公司成立於 1992 年 4 月，總部位於加州聖萊安德羅。

info.description: Ruanyun Edai Technology, Inc. provides artificial intelligence to educational institutions. It offers new teaching, learning, and assessment methods in the artificial intelligence. The firm involves in reforming traditional Chinese education and learning model by facilitating schools, teachers and students. The company was founded by Yan Fu and Cong Zhao on March 11, 2021 and is headquartered in Nanchang, China.
info.description_zh: 軟雲易貸科技有限公司為教育機構提供人工智慧。它提供了人工智慧領域新的教學、學習和評估方法。該公司致力於透過為學校、教師和學生提供便利來改革中國傳統的教育和學習模式。該公司由付岩和趙聰於2021年3月11日創立，總部位於中國南昌。

info.description: Biofrontera, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the commercialization of pharmaceutical products. It specializes in the treatment of dermatological conditions, caused primarily by exposure to sunlight that results in sun damage to the skin. The company focuses on the treatment of actinic keratosis and markets a topical antibiotic for treatment of impetigo. Its products include Ameluz and Xepi, its two prescription drugs, and BF-RhodoLED, a lamp used with Ameluz, for the lesion-directed and field-directed treatment of actinic keratosis of mild-to-moderate severity on the face and scalp. The company was founded on March 3, 2015 and is headquartered in Woburn, MA.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Biofrontera, Inc.是一家生物製藥公司，從事醫藥產品的商業化。它專門治療皮膚病，這些疾病主要是由於暴露在陽光下導致皮膚受到陽光損傷而引起的。該公司專注於光化性角化症的治療，並銷售用於治療膿皰瘡的外用抗生素。其產品包括兩種處方藥 Ameluz 和 Xepi，以及與 Ameluz 配合使用的 BF-RhodoLED 燈，用於針對面部和頭皮輕至中度嚴重的光化性角化病進行病灶定向和現場定向治療。該公司成立於2015年3月3日，總部位於麻薩諸塞州沃本。

info.description: InterCure Ltd. engages in the provision of business of medical cannabis and biomedicine. It operates through the Investments in Biomed Portfolio Companies in the Biomed Sector and Investments in the Medical Cannabis Sector segments. The company was founded by Benjamin Gavish and Erez Gavish on November 20, 1994 and is headquartered in Herzliya, Israel.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: InterCure Ltd.從事提供醫用大麻和生物醫學業務。它透過對生物醫學領域的生物醫學投資組合公司的投資和對醫用大麻領域的投資進行運作。該公司由Benjamin Gavish和Erez Gavish於1994年11月20日創立，總部位於以色列荷茲利亞。

info.description: Invesco DWA Technology Momentum ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Dorsey Wright Technology Technical Leaders Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index is composed of at least 30 securities of companies in the technology sector that have powerful relative strength or "momentum" characteristics.
info.description_zh: Invesco DWA Technology Momentum ETF 旨在追蹤 Dorsey Wright Technology Technical Leaders Index（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（扣除費用和開支之前）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。標的指數由至少 30 家科技業公司的證券組成，這些公司具有強大的相對實力或「動量」特徵。

info.description: Cipher Digital, Inc. operates as a Bitcoin mining ecosystem in the United States. The firm is developing a cryptocurrency business. The company was founded in 2021 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Cipher Digital, Inc. 在美國以比特幣挖礦生態系統運作。該公司正在開發加密貨幣業務。該公司成立於 2021 年，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Smartbird, Inc. is a global lifestyle brand that innovates with naturally derived materials to make footwear and apparel products in a better way, while treading lighter on the planet. It offers Men's Shoes, Women's Shoes, Men's Apparel, Women's Apparel, Socks, and Gift Cards. The company was founded by Timothy Brown and Joseph Zev Zwillinger on May 6, 2015 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Smartbird, Inc. 是一個全球生活風格品牌，利用天然材料進行創新，以更好的方式製造鞋類和服裝產品，同時在地球上邁出更輕的腳步。它提供男鞋、女鞋、男裝、女裝、襪子和禮品卡。 The company was founded by Timothy Brown and Joseph Zev Zwillinger on May 6, 2015 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long BULL Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of BULL. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of BULL, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 BULL 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 BULL 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來可提供 BULL 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: CVD Equipment Corp. engages in the design, development, and manufacture of chemical vapor deposition, gas control, and other state-of-the-art equipment and process solutions. It operates through the following segments: Chemical Vapor Deposition (CVD) Equipment, Stainless Design Concepts (SDC), and MesoScribe. The CVD Equipment segment includes manufacturing of chemical vapor deposition, physical vapor transport, and thermal process equipment. The SDC segment focuses on manufacturing of ultra-high purity gas and chemical delivery control systems. The MesoScribe segment provides electronic printing services and products. The company was founded by Leonard A. Rosenbaum on October 13, 1982 and is headquartered in Central Islip, NY.
info.description_zh: CVD Equipment Corp. 從事化學氣相沉積、氣體控制以及其他最先進的設備和製程解決方案的設計、開發和製造。該公司透過以下部門運作：化學氣相沉積 (CVD) 設備部門、不銹鋼設計概念 (SDC) 部門和 MesoScribe 部門。 CVD 設備部門包括化學氣相沉積、物理氣相傳輸和熱處理設備的製造。 SDC 部門專注於超高純度氣體和化學品輸送控制系統的製造。 MesoScribe 部門提供電子列印服務和產品。該公司由 Leonard A. Rosenbaum 於 1982 年 10 月 13 日創立，總部位於紐約州中部艾斯利普。

info.description: OneConstruction Group Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the procurement and installation of structural steel for construction projects. It is involved in performing site preparatory and preliminary works, developing detailed work schedules and work allocation plans, implementing construction site works, and conducting site safety supervision and quality control. The company was founded in 2021 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: OneConstruction Group Ltd. 是一家控股公司，從事建築項目結構鋼的採購和安裝業務。它參與進行現場準備和前期工作，制定詳細的工作時間表和工作分配計劃，實施施工現場工作，並進行現場安全監督和品質控制。該公司成立於2021年，總部位於香港。

info.description: Kala Bio, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company. It focuses on the development and commercialization of therapeutics using proprietary nanoparticle-based mucus penetrating particles with an initial focus on the treatment of eye diseases. The company was founded by Justin Hanes, Robert S. Langer and Colin R. Gardner in 2009 and is headquartered in Arlington, MA.
info.description_zh: Kala Bio, Inc.是一家生物製藥公司。它專注於使用專有的基於奈米顆粒的黏液穿透顆粒進行治療的開發和商業化，最初的重點是眼部疾病的治療。該公司由 Justin Hanes、Robert S. Langer 和 Colin R. Gardner 於 2009 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州阿靈頓。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long CIFR Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of CIFR. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in the Underlying Security and financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of CIFR, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 CIFR 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 CIFR 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於標的證券和具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來提供 CIFR 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: XCHG Ltd. engages in the business of designing, manufacturing, and selling electric vehicle chargers. It offers comprehensive electric vehicle charging solutions which primarily include DC fast chargers, advanced battery-integrated DC fast chargers, as well as its accompanying services. The company was founded by Yi Fei Hou and Rui Ding in 2015 and is headquartered in Hamburg, Germany.
info.description_zh: XCHG Ltd.從事設計、製造和銷售電動車充電器的業務。它提供全面的電動車充電解決方案，主要包括直流快速充電器、先進的電池整合直流快速充電器及其配套服務。該公司由侯逸飛和丁銳於2015年創立，總部位於德國漢堡。

info.description: NeoVolta, Inc. engages in the designing, manufacturing, and developing of residential energy storage systems (ESS). Its products include: NV14, NV24, NVPlus, NV7600, and NV16. The company was founded by Brent Willson on March 5, 2018 and is headquartered in Poway, CA.
